words.ex: I need a bit of time to finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我需要一点时间来完成我的作业。
words.en: A small amount of something.

words.tr: 短语. 一份……的副本；一本……的复制品
words.ex: He asked for a copy of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他要了一份信的副本。
words.en: a duplicate or reproduction of an original document or item

words.ex: I need a couple of minutes to finish this.
words.ex_cn: 我需要几分钟来完成这个。
words.en: A couple of is used to refer to a small number of things or people, usually two or a few more than two.

words.tr: 短语，表示“一杯……”，用于计量饮品或其他可盛于杯中的物质，如 a cup of tea（一杯茶）
words.ex: He drank a cup of water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了一杯水。
words.en: A cup of is used to refer to the quantity of a drink contained in a cup.

words.ex: I have a few apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我桌上有一些苹果。
words.en: A small number of things or people.

words.ex: A dog is a kind of animal.
words.ex_cn: 狗是一种动物。
words.en: a type or sort of something

words.ex: He has a lot of books.
words.ex_cn: 他有很多书。
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.ex: There are lots of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.ex: A number of students are late for class.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生上课迟到了。
words.en: An indefinite but considerable amount or quantity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 一块；一张；一片；一件
words.ex: He ate a piece of bread.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一片面包。
words.en: A portion or part of something.

words.ex: Above all, be kind to others.
words.ex_cn: 最重要的是，对他人要善良。
words.en: Most importantly; especially.

words.ex: The results according to the data are surprising.
words.ex_cn: 根据数据，结果令人惊讶。
words.en: In a manner corresponding to something stated or understood.

words.ex: He works hard to achieve his dreams.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的梦想。
words.en: To successfully reach or realize one's dreams or goals.

words.tr: phrase. 在……对面；与……隔街相对
words.ex: The bank is across from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 银行在邮局的对面。
words.en: prep. on the opposite side of something

words.ex: The new rules add to the cost.
words.ex_cn: 新规定增加了成本。
words.en: To put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount.

words.tr: phrase. 过一会儿；不久之后
words.ex: He waited after a while and then left.
words.ex_cn: 他等了一会儿，然后离开了。
words.en: After a period of time.

words.ex: He didn't win, but after all, he tried his best.
words.ex_cn: 他没有赢，但毕竟他尽了最大努力。
words.en: You use after all when you are saying that something that you thought might not be the case is in fact the case.

words.tr: phrase. 再三地；反复不止地
words.ex: He tried again and again to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他一遍又一遍地尝试解决这个问题。
words.en: Repeatedly; many times.

words.tr: phrase. 对...达成协议；对...取得一致意见
words.ex: They agree on the plan for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们对旅行的计划达成一致。
words.en: To reach a mutual understanding or consensus about something.

words.ex: He agree to help me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他同意帮我做作业。
words.en: To consent to do something that has been suggested by another person.

words.tr: phrase. 赞同； 同意； 适合于
words.ex: I agree with you on this point.
words.ex_cn: 我同意你的这个观点。
words.en: to have the same opinion as someone else; to accept a suggestion or idea

words.tr: phrase. v. 旨在；针对；以…为目标
words.ex: This program aims at helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目旨在帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: If you aim at something, you direct your efforts or actions towards achieving it.

words.ex: He did the homework all by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他完全独自完成了作业。
words.en: Without any help from anyone else; completely alone.

words.ex: He played video games all day.
words.ex_cn: 他一整天都在玩电子游戏。
words.en: Throughout the entire day.

words.ex: He played video games all day long.
words.ex_cn: 他一整天都在玩电子游戏。
words.en: Throughout the entire day; from morning until night.

words.tr: phrase. 总的来说；整体而言
words.ex: All in all, the trip was fun and cheap.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，这次旅行又好玩又便宜。
words.en: When you say all in all, you are summarizing a situation or expressing a general opinion about it.

words.tr: phrase. 各种各样的；各种类型的
words.ex: He collects all kinds of stamps.
words.ex_cn: 他收集各种各样的邮票。
words.en: A phrase used to indicate a variety of different types or kinds of something.

words.ex: He is all over the place today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天到处跑。
words.en: In every part of a place; everywhere.

words.ex: People all over the world like chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 全世界的人都喜欢巧克力。
words.en: everywhere in the world

words.ex: People all around the world celebrate New Year.
words.ex_cn: 世界各地的人们庆祝新年。
words.en: in every part of the world; worldwide

words.ex: All right, let's go now.
words.ex_cn: 好吧，我们现在走吧。
words.en: If you say that something is all right, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

words.tr: phrase. 尽管如此；仍然；还是
words.ex: He didn't study, but all the same, he passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有学习，但尽管如此，他还是通过了考试。
words.en: Despite that; nevertheless.

words.ex: He is talking all the time.
words.ex_cn: 他一直在说话。
words.en: If something happens or is done all the time, it happens or is done continually or repeatedly.

words.tr: phrase. 一年到头； 全年
words.ex: She plays tennis all year round.
words.ex_cn: 她全年都打网球。
words.en: If something happens all year round, it happens throughout the year.

words.tr: phrase. 与...在一起；沿着；除此之外，还…
words.ex: He bought apples along with oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果，还买了橙子。
words.en: in addition to someone or something else; together with someone or something else

words.ex: He bought apples, bananas, and so on.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果、香蕉等等。
words.en: Used at the end of a list to indicate that there are other items that could also be mentioned.

words.ex: He answered the phone quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速接了电话。
words.en: to respond to an incoming telephone call

words.ex: He apologizes for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而道歉。
words.en: To express regret for something that one has done wrong, especially in a formal or polite way to someone.

words.ex: They often argue about politics.
words.ex_cn: 他们经常争论政治问题。
words.en: to speak angrily to someone, telling them that you disagree with them

words.ex: He likes to argue with his brother about football.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢和他哥哥争论足球。
words.en: If one person argues with another, they speak angrily to each other about something that they disagree about.

words.ex: We arrive at the station at 9 o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 我们九点到达车站。
words.en: To reach a destination or to come to a decision or conclusion after consideration.

words.ex: He didn't study hard, as a result, he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有努力学习，结果考试不及格。
words.en: used to introduce the consequence or effect of a particular situation or event

words.ex: As for homework, I finished it yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 至于作业，我昨天就完成了。
words.en: used to start talking about someone or something

words.tr: phrase. 好像...似的； 仿佛...一样
words.ex: He talks as if he knows everything.
words.ex_cn: 他说话的样子好像什么都知道。
words.en: used to describe how someone or something appears or behaves, suggesting that the appearance or behavior is not real or true

words.tr: phrase. 好像...似的； 仿佛...一样
words.ex: He talks as though he knows everything.
words.ex_cn: 他说话的样子好像什么都知道。
words.en: used to describe how someone or something seems to be, or how someone behaves, when this is not the real situation

words.tr: phrase. 只要；长达；和 ... 一样长
words.ex: You can stay out as long as you come home before midnight.
words.ex_cn: 只要你午夜前回家，你就可以在外面待着。
words.en: used to say that one thing is true or will happen only if another thing is true or happens

words.ex: He will call me as soon as he arrives.
words.ex_cn: 他一到就会给我打电话。
words.en: At the moment that; immediately after.

words.tr: phrase. 尽快，尽早（表示某事应以最快速度完成）
words.ex: Please send the report as soon as possible.
words.ex_cn: 请尽快发送报告。
words.en: If you say that something will happen as soon as possible, you mean that it will happen as quickly as it can.

words.ex: He arrived late, as usual.
words.ex_cn: 他像往常一样迟到了。
words.en: As usual means in the same way as what happens most of the time or in most cases.

words.ex: He likes coffee, and he likes tea as well.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，也喜欢茶。
words.en: In addition to something else; also.

words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.ex: He asks for help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: To request something; to express a desire for something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 请求某人的许可；征求某人同意
words.ex: He asked my permission before using my phone.
words.ex_cn: 他在使用我的手机之前征求了我的同意。
words.en: To request approval or consent from someone before doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 早餐时；正在吃早饭
words.ex: He eats toast at breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃吐司。
words.en: During the first meal of the day.

words.ex: We eat sandwiches at lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我们在午餐时吃三明治。
words.en: During the midday meal.

words.ex: They talk about their day at supper.
words.ex_cn: 他们在吃晚饭时谈论一天的事情。
words.en: during the evening meal; while eating dinner

words.ex: At first, he did not like math.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他不喜欢数学。
words.en: At the beginning; initially.

words.ex: He finished his homework at last.
words.ex_cn: 他终于完成了作业。
words.en: After a long time or delay; finally.

words.ex: I need at least three apples to make a pie.
words.ex_cn: 我至少需要三个苹果来做派。
words.en: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

words.ex: He sleeps at night.
words.ex_cn: 他晚上睡觉。
words.en: During the night; in the nighttime.

words.ex: We eat lunch at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃午饭。
words.en: At noon means at 12 o'clock in the middle of the day.

words.ex: He stopped talking at once.
words.ex_cn: 他立刻停止了说话。
words.en: Immediately; without delay; at the same time.

words.ex: At present, he is working as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 目前，他是一名老师。
words.en: At the present time; now.

words.ex: He is at school now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在在上学。
words.en: In the location of a school; attending school as a pupil.

words.tr: 短语. 在进餐时；在吃饭
words.ex: He is eating at table with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他正和家人在餐桌旁吃饭。
words.en: At table means sitting at a table, especially for a meal.

words.ex: He started school at the age of six.
words.ex_cn: 他六岁时开始上学。
words.en: Used to indicate the specific age at which something happens or someone does something.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的后面；位于……的背部或后方
words.ex: The cat is at the back of the room.
words.ex_cn: 猫在房间的后面。
words.en: Located directly behind something.

words.ex: At the beginning of the class, the teacher gave us homework.
words.ex_cn: 在课程开始时，老师给我们布置了作业。
words.en: At the start of something; at the point when something starts.

words.ex: The café is at the corner of Main Street and Park Avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆在主街和公园大道的拐角处。
words.en: Located at the point where two lines, edges, or sides meet.

words.tr: 短语. 在医生的诊所；在看医生
words.ex: He is at the doctor's today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天在医生那里。
words.en: At the doctor's refers to being in the location of a doctor's office or clinic, typically for a medical consultation or treatment.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的边缘；接近……的边缘状态
words.ex: The boy is standing at the edge of the cliff.
words.ex_cn: 男孩站在悬崖边上。
words.en: at the outermost point or boundary of something

words.ex: He will call you at the end of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他会在会议结束时给你打电话。
words.en: Indicates the final part of a period of time, an event, a process, or a physical object.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的底部；在……的山脚；在……的起点
words.ex: The house is at the foot of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 房子在山脚下。
words.en: At the base or bottom part of something.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的前面；位于……的前部
words.ex: He stands at the front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他站在教室的前面。
words.en: Located at the foremost part or position of something.

words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子前面。
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.ex: He was busy at the moment.
words.ex_cn: 当时他很忙。
words.en: At the moment is used to indicate that something is happening now.

words.tr: phrase. 同时；但是；在相同的时间
words.ex: He sings and dances at the same time.
words.ex_cn: 他一边唱歌一边跳舞。
words.en: If two or more things exist, happen, or are true at the same time, they exist, happen, or are true together although they seem to contradict each other.

words.ex: He screamed at the sight of a snake.
words.ex_cn: 他一看到蛇就尖叫了。
words.en: Upon seeing something or someone, immediately.

words.ex: The car moves at the speed of light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车以光速行驶。
words.en: moving or occurring at a specified rate of motion or progress

words.ex: He plays football at weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他在周末踢足球。
words.en: During the weekend; typically referring to Saturday and Sunday.

words.ex: He is at work right now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在工作。
words.en: If someone is at work, they are doing their job or are busy doing a particular activity.

words.ex: He avoids eating too much sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他避免吃太多糖。
words.en: To refrain from performing a specific action.

words.tr: phrase. 能够做某事；有能力完成某事
words.ex_cn: 他能游得很好。
words.en: To have the necessary skill, knowledge, time, money, or opportunity to do something.

words.tr: 表示即将做某事，用于描述马上要发生的动作，后接动词原形
words.ex: He is about to leave the house.
words.ex_cn: 他正要离开家。
words.en: If you are about to do something, you are going to do it very soon.

words.tr: phrase. 害怕某事；对某事感到恐惧
words.ex_cn: 他害怕蜘蛛。
words.en: To feel fear or anxiety about a particular thing or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 害怕做某事；担心会发生某种不好的结果
words.ex_cn: 他害怕犯错。
words.en: To feel fear or anxiety about doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 被允许做某事；可以做某事
words.ex: He is allowed to go out after finishing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做完作业后被允许出去。
words.en: To have permission to do something.

words.ex: My mom is angry with me for coming home late.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈因为我回家晚而生我的气。
words.en: To feel or show anger towards someone because of something they have done.

words.ex: He is asleep now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在睡着了。
words.en: To be in the state of sleep.

words.tr: phrase. v. 离开；不在某地；远离
words.ex: He is away from school today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天不在学校。
words.en: To be in a place that is not near or close to a particular location or person.

words.ex: Smoking is bad for your lungs.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的肺有害。
words.en: To have a harmful or negative effect on someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为基础；以…为根据
words.ex: The plan is based on simple rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是基于简单规则的。
words.en: If something is based on something else, it uses it as the thing from which it develops.

words.tr: phrase. 对…视而不见；忽视；无视（某事物）
words.ex: He is blind to his own mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他看不到自己的错误。
words.en: If you are blind to something, you are unaware of it or you ignore it.

words.ex: He was born in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: To come into existence or to be brought into life in a particular place.

words.ex: He is busy with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正忙于做作业。
words.en: To be actively engaged in a task or activity.

words.ex_cn: 他正在忙于做作业。
words.en: To be occupied or actively engaged in doing something.

words.tr: 短语. 小心；注意；当心
words.ex: Be careful when you cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 过马路时要小心。
words.en: To be cautious and attentive in order to avoid potential danger or mistakes.

words.tr: phrase. 一定要做某事；务必做某事
words.ex_cn: 他一定会赢得比赛。
words.en: To make sure to do something without fail.

words.ex_cn: 学校离公园很近。
words.en: To be near in space, time, or relationship.

words.ex: The ground is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 地面被雪覆盖。
words.en: To have something spread over or upon a surface.

words.tr: 短语动词. 挤满了……；充满……
words.ex: The market is crowded with people on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 周末市场里挤满了人。
words.en: To be filled with a large number of people or things in a way that makes movement or access difficult.

words.ex: This book is different from that one.
words.ex_cn: 这本书和那本书不一样。
words.en: To not be the same as something or someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 在……方面有经验的；擅长……的
words.ex_cn: 他有教授英语的经验。
words.en: To have knowledge or skill gained through practice in a specific area.

words.ex: This song is familiar to him.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌对他来说很熟悉。
words.en: If something is familiar to you, you recognize it or know it well.

words.tr: phrase. 以……而闻名；作为……出名
words.ex: He is famous as a singer.
words.ex_cn: 他以歌手的身份而出名。
words.en: To be well known for a particular quality or skill.

words.ex: He is famous for singing beautiful songs.
words.ex_cn: 他因演唱动听的歌曲而闻名。
words.en: be widely known or recognized for a particular quality or achievement

words.ex_cn: 他离准备好还很远。
words.en: If something is far from a particular thing or quality, it is not that thing or quality at all.

words.tr: phrase. 对...感到厌烦；受够了...
words.ex: He is fed up with doing the same work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天做同样的工作。
words.en: To be bored, annoyed, or unhappy, especially with a situation that has existed for a long time.

words.ex: The room is filled with laughter.
words.ex_cn: 房间里充满了笑声。
words.en: To have a lot of a particular quality or thing.

words.tr: phrase. 适合……的；具备……资格的
words.ex_cn: 他不适合这份工作。
words.en: To be suitable or appropriate for a particular purpose or role.

words.ex: He is fond of playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢踢足球。
words.en: To have a liking or affection for someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 免于；摆脱（某事物），不受……的困扰
words.ex: He wants to be free from stress.
words.ex_cn: 他想摆脱压力。
words.en: To not have or be affected by something unwanted.

words.ex_cn: 他对同学很友好。
words.en: To behave in a kind and pleasant way towards someone.

words.tr: phrase. 害怕做某事；不敢做某事
words.ex_cn: 他害怕在全班面前说话。
words.en: To be afraid or scared to perform a certain action.

words.ex: The box is full of toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子里装满了玩具。
words.en: To contain or hold as much or as many as possible; to be filled with something.

words.ex_cn: 雨已经停了。
words.en: To no longer be present; to have left or disappeared.

words.ex: He is good at math.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长数学。
words.en: To have a natural ability or skill in a particular area.

words.ex: Eating vegetables is good for your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康有好处。
words.en: To be beneficial or advantageous for someone or something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 卧病在床；因生病而躺在床上
words.ex: He is ill in bed with a cold.
words.ex_cn: 他感冒了，躺在床上。
words.en: To be confined to bed due to illness.

words.tr: phrase. 在里面；在家；在（某组织或状态）中
words.ex_cn: 他在教室里。
words.en: To be located within a particular place or thing.

words.tr: phrase. 达成一致；意见相同
words.ex: They are in agreement about the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他们对这个计划意见一致。
words.en: To share the same opinion or decision with someone.

words.ex: He is interested in math.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学感兴趣。
words.en: To have a feeling of curiosity or concern about something, wanting to learn or know more about it.

words.tr: phrase. 热衷于；喜爱；对…极感兴趣
words.ex: He is keen on playing football.
words.ex_cn: 他非常热衷于踢足球。
words.en: If you are keen on something, you like it a lot and are very enthusiastic about it.

words.ex_cn: 善待自己，需要时休息一下。
words.en: To treat someone in a gentle, caring, and considerate way.

words.ex: He is known as a great teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被称为一位优秀的老师。
words.en: If someone or something is known as a particular name, they are called by that name.

words.ex: He is late for school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都上学迟到。
words.en: To arrive somewhere after the expected or usual time.

words.ex: His headaches are linked to too much screen time.
words.ex_cn: 他的头痛与过多的屏幕时间有关。
words.en: To be connected or associated with something or someone.

words.ex: He is mad at his brother for breaking his toy.
words.ex_cn: 他因为弟弟弄坏了玩具而生他的气。
words.en: To feel or show anger towards someone.

words.ex: The table is made from wood.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是用木头做的。
words.en: Created or produced using a particular material or substance as the main component.

words.tr: 由……制成（表示材料，强调原材料未发生根本性变化）
words.ex: The table is made of wood.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是木头做的。
words.en: If something is made of a particular material, that material was used to build it.

words.tr: 用于被动语态，表示被迫或被要求做某事
words.ex: He was made to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 他被要求打扫房间。
words.en: If someone is made to do something, they are forced or required to do it.

words.ex: The team is made up of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something is made up of particular things or people, it consists of those things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 被……感动的；因……而动情的
words.ex_cn: 她被这个悲伤的故事感动了。
words.en: To be emotionally affected by something, often in a way that inspires compassion, sadness, or admiration.

words.tr: phrase. 走开；离开；出发；不上班
words.ex_cn: 他现在去学校了。
words.en: To leave a place or to stop operating or functioning.

words.tr: phrase. 开放；易受到；易遭受
words.ex_cn: 他愿意接受新想法。
words.en: To be willing to consider or accept something.

words.ex: He is pleased with his test score.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的考试成绩感到满意。
words.en: To feel satisfaction or happiness about something.

words.tr: phrase. 在……方面缺乏的；在……方面不足的
words.ex_cn: 他数学不好。
words.en: To lack or be deficient in a particular quality or resource.

words.ex: My mom is proud of me because I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈为我通过考试而感到骄傲。
words.en: To feel a sense of pride or satisfaction in something or someone.

words.ex: This soil is rich in nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 这种土壤富含养分。
words.en: To contain a large amount of something beneficial or valuable.

words.tr: phrase. 为……感到难过；为……感到悲伤
words.ex_cn: 他为他丢失的狗感到难过。
words.en: To feel sorrow or unhappiness for someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 认真对待…；对…是认真的
words.ex: He is serious about learning English.
words.ex_cn: 他认真对待学英语。
words.en: If you are serious about something, you are sincere about it and consider it to be important.

words.tr: phrase. 是……的缩写；是……的简称
words.ex: The name 'Bob' is short for Robert.
words.ex_cn: ‘Bob’是‘Robert’的缩写。
words.en: If something is short for a particular word or name, it is a shorter way of saying or writing it.

words.ex: We are short of money to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 我们缺钱买食物。
words.en: If you are short of something, you do not have enough of it. If something is short of a place, it is not as far as that place.

words.tr: phrase. 类似于； 与 ... 相似
words.ex: This apple is similar to that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.tr: phrase. 为…感到抱歉；同情某人
words.ex: I am sorry for breaking your cup.
words.ex_cn: 我为打碎你的杯子感到抱歉。
words.en: To feel regret or sadness about something.

words.ex: He wore a strange hat to school.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去学校。
words.en: If something is strange, it is unusual or unexpected, and makes you feel slightly nervous or afraid.

words.tr: phrase. 感到压力很大；紧张过度；精疲力尽
words.ex_cn: 他因为太多作业而感到压力很大。
words.en: To be in a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.ex_cn: 我的老师对作业要求严格。
words.en: To adhere firmly to rules or standards in a particular area.

words.ex: You are supposed to finish your homework before you go out to play.
words.ex_cn: 你应该在出去玩之前完成作业。
words.en: If you are supposed to do something, it means that you are expected or required to do it.

words.tr: 务必做某事；一定要做某事
words.ex: Be sure to finish your homework before you go out to play.
words.ex_cn: 在出去玩之前，一定要完成你的作业。
words.en: To make certain to do something; to ensure that something is done.

words.ex: He is surprised at the small price.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个便宜的价格感到惊讶。
words.en: To feel astonishment or disbelief about something.

words.tr: phrase. 在……方面有天赋的；在……方面有才能的
words.ex_cn: 她在弹钢琴方面很有天赋。
words.en: To have a natural ability to do something well, especially in the arts.

words.tr: phrase. 非常害怕的；极度恐惧的
words.ex: She is terrified of spiders.
words.ex_cn: 她对蜘蛛感到惊恐。
words.en: To be extremely afraid of something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 对某人心存感激；感谢某人
words.ex_cn: 我感谢我的老师帮助我。
words.en: To express gratitude to someone for something they have done or given.

words.ex: He is tired of eating the same food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天吃同样的食物。
words.en: To feel that you have had enough of someone or something and do not want to have to deal with them or it any more.

words.tr: phrase. 由…决定；是…的职责；从事；胜任
words.ex_cn: 这个周末你打算做什么？
words.en: Used to ask or talk about what someone is doing or planning to do.

words.tr: phrase. 被用作；被当作……使用
words.ex: This tool can be used as a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具可以被用作锤子。
words.en: To function or serve in a particular capacity or role.

words.ex: This tool can be used for various purposes.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具可以用来做各种用途。
words.en: To indicate the purpose or function of something.

words.ex: He used to play soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 他过去每天踢足球。
words.en: If something used to be done or used to be the case, it was done regularly in the past or was the case in the past.

words.ex: He is used to waking up early for work.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯早起上班。
words.en: To be accustomed to doing something, implying that the action is familiar or habitual.

words.ex_cn: 他逐渐习惯了早起上班。
words.en: To become familiar with something or someone so that it/they no longer seem(s) strange or unusual.

words.ex: He is willing to help his friend with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他愿意帮朋友做作业。
words.en: If you are willing to do something, you are ready and eager to do it and have no objection to doing it.

words.ex_cn: 经过一天漫长的工作后，她感到筋疲力尽。
words.en: To be extremely tired or to have something so used that it is no longer in good condition.

words.ex: He is worried about his math test.
words.ex_cn: 他担心他的数学考试。
words.en: To feel anxious or concerned about someone or something.

words.ex: It is worth taking the time to read this book.
words.ex_cn: 花时间读这本书是值得的。
words.en: If something is worth doing, it is important or useful, and you should do it.

words.ex: He was late because of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他因为公交车而迟到了。
words.en: You use 'because of' to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

words.ex: Before long, he will finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 不久之后，他就会完成作业。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or is true before long, you mean that it will happen or is true soon.

words.tr: 短语动词. 恳求某人做某事
words.ex: I beg you to reconsider your decision.
words.ex_cn: 我恳求你重新考虑你的决定。
words.en: To ask someone earnestly or humbly to do something.

words.ex: He begins his day with a cup of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他每天以一杯咖啡开始一天。
words.en: To start an activity or process using a particular element or method.

words.ex: I believe in working hard to achieve my dreams.
words.ex_cn: 我相信努力工作能实现我的梦想。
words.en: To feel certain that something exists or is true, or to have confidence in a person or thing.

words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.ex: The cat is sitting between the two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在两把椅子之间。
words.en: If something is between two things or is in between them, it has one of the things on one side of it and the other thing on the other side.

words.ex: I will borrow a book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我将从图书馆借一本书。
words.en: To take and use something that belongs to someone else with the intention of returning it.

words.ex: Both my mother and my father are teachers.
words.ex_cn: 我的妈妈和爸爸都是老师。
words.en: Used to emphasize that each of two things is true or happens, often to stress the inclusion of both items or ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.ex: The thief tried to break into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷试图在夜里闯入房子。
words.en: To enter a building or car using force, in order to steal something; to suddenly start doing something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 打碎；破碎；分裂成碎片
words.ex: The glass fell and broke into pieces.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃掉下来摔成了碎片。
words.en: To break something into pieces means to cause it to separate into smaller parts, often by applying force.

words.tr: phrase. 中断；突然停止；断绝（关系）；休息一会
words.ex: He broke off the conversation when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响时，他中断了对话。
words.en: To suddenly stop doing something, especially speaking.

words.ex: The fire broke out in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 火在厨房里突然烧了起来。
words.en: If something such as war, fighting, or disease breaks out, it begins suddenly.

words.ex: He runs fast and breaks the record.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，打破了纪录。
words.en: To surpass a previously established high score or performance level.

words.tr: phrase. 违反规则；打破规定
words.ex: He broke the rule by using his phone in class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课时使用手机，违反了规定。
words.en: To violate or not follow a rule or set of rules.

words.tr: phrase. 打碎；分裂；解体；结束；期终放假
words.ex: He broke up the ice with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把冰打碎了。
words.en: To end a relationship or to disintegrate into pieces.

words.tr: phrase. 使表现出；说出；呈出；出版
words.ex: The new lighting really brings out the colors in the painting.
words.ex_cn: 新灯光让画中的颜色更加突出。
words.en: To cause something to be seen or known; to publish something.

words.tr: 短语动词，表示将某物或某人带到某个地方或某种状态，例如：bring something to a place（把某物带到某地），bring someone to justice（将某人绳之以法）
words.ex: He brings his lunch to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天把午饭带到学校。
words.en: To carry or convey something to a place or person.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；教育；养育；呕出
words.ex: He brought up an important point in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个重要的观点。
words.en: To mention a subject or start to talk about it; to care for a child until they are an adult, often giving them particular beliefs; to educate someone; to vomit.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；逐步增长；加强
words.ex: He builds up his strength by running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天跑步来增强体力。
words.en: To increase or develop something gradually; to accumulate or amass something over time.

words.ex: He broke the vase by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打碎了花瓶。
words.en: If something happens by accident, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.ex: He sent the package by air.
words.ex_cn: 他通过空运寄出了包裹。
words.en: Using aircraft as a means of transport.

words.ex: We went to the park by car.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘汽车去的公园。
words.en: Using a car as a means of transportation.

words.ex: I met my old friend by chance at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市碰巧遇到了我的老朋友。
words.en: If something happens by chance, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.ex: You can improve your English by doing more reading.
words.ex_cn: 通过多阅读，你可以提高你的英语水平。
words.en: Through the act of doing something.

words.ex: He cleaned the floor by means of a mop.
words.ex_cn: 他用拖把打扫了地板。
words.en: If you do something by means of a particular method, instrument, or process, you do it using that method, instrument, or process.

words.ex: I took his book by mistake.
words.ex_cn: 我误拿了她的书。
words.en: If you do something by mistake, you do it without intending to, because you have confused it with something else or because you are not paying attention.

words.ex: He did the homework by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他独自完成了作业。
words.en: Without help from anyone else; alone.

words.ex: By the end of the week, he finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到周末结束时，他完成了作业。
words.en: Indicates the point in time when something concludes or is expected to conclude.

words.ex: By the time he arrived, the class had already started.
words.ex_cn: 他到的时候，课已经开始了。
words.en: Indicates that something has already happened before a particular time.

words.tr: phrase. 顺便说说；顺便提起
words.ex: By the way, I saw your brother yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 对了，我昨天看到你弟弟了。
words.en: used to introduce a comment or question that is not directly related to the main subject of conversation

words.tr: phrase. 到那时；到那个时间
words.ex: By then, he had finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到那时，他已经完成了作业。
words.en: By then is used to refer to a time in the future when something will have happened or been completed.

words.ex: He laughs and cries by turns.
words.ex_cn: 他一会儿笑，一会儿哭。
words.en: If people do something by turns, they do it one after the other in a repeated order.

words.tr: phrase. v. 访问（某地）；停靠（某地）
words.ex: He will call at the post office after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会去邮局。
words.en: To visit a place, especially briefly, or to stop at a place during a journey.

words.ex: He made a loud call for help when he fell into the river.
words.ex_cn: 他掉进河里时大声呼救。
words.en: To request assistance or support, especially in a situation of danger or difficulty.

words.tr: 短语动词. 打电话报警；叫警察
words.ex: If you see a crime, call the police.
words.ex_cn: 如果你看到犯罪，就报警。
words.en: To contact the police in order to report a crime or emergency.

words.tr: phrase. 给…打电话；使想起；召集
words.ex: He called up his friend to say hello.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友打电话问好。
words.en: To telephone someone; to summon someone to military service; to bring something back to one's mind.

words.tr: phrase. 平静下来；镇定下来
words.ex: Please calm down and talk slowly.
words.ex_cn: 请冷静下来，慢慢说。
words.en: To become or make someone become quiet and relaxed after being angry, excited, or nervous.

words.tr: phrase. 情不自禁做某事；忍不住做某事
words.ex: I can't help laughing when I see that movie.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到那部电影时，我忍不住笑。
words.en: If you say that you can't help doing something, you mean that you can't prevent yourself from doing it.

words.ex: He cares about his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他在乎他的朋友们。
words.en: If you care about something, you feel that it is important and are concerned about it.

words.tr: phrase. 照料；关怀；喜欢；想要
words.ex: She cares for her sick mother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她生病的母亲。
words.en: To like or love someone or something; to look after someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 继续；坚持；进行；开展
words.ex: He will carry on working after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会继续工作。
words.en: If you carry on, you continue doing something.

words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.ex: If you go outside without a coat, you might catch cold.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不穿外套就出门，可能会感冒。
words.en: To become ill with a cold.

words.ex: He goes out without a coat and catches a cold.
words.ex_cn: 他出去时没穿外套，结果感冒了。
words.en: To become ill with a cold.

words.tr: phrase. 赶上；逮捕并处罚；（麻烦事）缠上
words.ex: He needs to catch up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他需要赶上他的同学。
words.en: To reach the same standard or level as someone or something else, especially after a period of lagging behind.

words.ex: He changed his mind and decided to go to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他改变了主意，决定去参加派对。
words.en: If you change your mind, you make a different decision or have a different opinion from the one you had before.

words.tr:
v. 聊天；
n. 聊天；
words.ex: They chat every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后聊天。
words.en: To talk in a friendly and informal way.

words.ex: She decided to clean out the garage this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 她决定这个周末打扫车库。
words.en: To clean out means to remove everything from a place and clean it thoroughly.

words.tr: phrase. 打扫干净；收拾整洁
words.ex: They clean up the room every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每星期六打扫房间。
words.en: To make a place or thing clean and tidy by removing dirt, rubbish, or unwanted items.

words.tr: phrase. 清理；澄清；解决；放晴
words.ex: He helped to clear up the toys after playtime.
words.ex_cn: 他帮忙在玩完后收拾玩具。
words.en: To remove things that are causing a mess or obstruction; to explain something that was unclear; for the weather to become fine.

words.ex: The boy climbs up the tree to get the ball.
words.ex_cn: 男孩爬上去树上拿球。
words.en: To move upwards, especially by using the hands and feet.

words.ex: He checks in at the hotel at 3 PM.
words.ex_cn: 他在下午三点办理入住。
words.en: To announce your arrival, especially at a hotel or an airport, by signing your name or showing your ticket.

words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使高兴起来；振作起来
words.ex: He smiled to cheer up his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着让妹妹振作起来。
words.en: If someone cheers up, or if something cheers them up, they start to feel happier.

words.tr: phrase. v. 关闭；停业；终止运营
words.ex: The shop will close down next week.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店将在下周关门。
words.en: If a business or organization closes down or if someone closes it down, it stops operating permanently.

words.tr: phrase. 偶遇；偶然发现；使产生…印象
words.ex: I came across an old photo while cleaning my room.
words.ex_cn: 我在打扫房间时发现了一张旧照片。
words.en: If you come across something or someone, you find them or meet them by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；跟随；进步；（催促）赶快
words.ex: I didn't see him, but he came along later.
words.ex_cn: 我没看到他，但他后来出现了。
words.en: To appear or arrive, often unexpectedly; to make progress or improve.

words.tr: phrase. 来来去去；出现又消失；来往
words.ex: People come and go in the market all day.
words.ex_cn: 市场上的人们整天来来往往。
words.en: To move or travel to a place and then leave it again, often repeatedly.

words.tr: phrase. 回来；记起；复原；恢复；重新流行
words.ex: He promised to come back soon.
words.ex_cn: 他答应很快就会回来。
words.en: To return to a place or to a previous activity or condition.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 下来；下降；流传；病倒
words.ex: The price of apples came down last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周苹果的价格降了。
words.en: To move or travel from a higher to a lower level or position; to descend.

words.ex: He comes from a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他来自一个小村庄。
words.en: To originate or hail from a particular place or background.

words.ex: He comes in every morning at 8 o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上8点进来。
words.en: To enter a place, especially a building or room.

words.tr: phrase. 加油；快点；拜托；来吧；开始
words.ex: Come on, you can finish this race!
words.ex_cn: 加油，你能跑完这场比赛的！
words.en: Used to encourage someone to do something or to hurry up, or to express disbelief or skepticism.

words.ex: The sun comes out after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨停后太阳出来了。
words.en: If something comes out, it becomes known, especially after it has been kept secret or it has been unknown.

words.tr: phrase. 过来；顺便来访；改变立场；突然感觉；显得
words.ex: Come over to my house after school.
words.ex_cn: 放学后到我家来。
words.en: To move or travel towards someone or something, especially in order to visit them.

words.ex: The movie comes to an end at nine o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 电影在九点结束。
words.en: To reach a point where something stops or finishes.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐了解到；开始明白
words.ex: It took him years to come to know the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他花了多年时间才得知真相。
words.en: To gradually become aware of or familiar with something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 苏醒过来；变得活跃；显得逼真
words.ex: The painting seems to come to life in the moonlight.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在月光下似乎活了过来。
words.en: To become active or lively; to start to function or operate.

words.ex: After fainting, she slowly came to herself.
words.ex_cn: 在昏倒后，她慢慢苏醒了过来。
words.en: To regain consciousness or one's normal state of mind after being unconscious or confused.

words.ex: Her dream will come true next year.
words.ex_cn: 她的梦想明年将会实现。
words.en: If a dream, hope, or prediction comes true, it actually happens.

words.ex: The temperature came up to 30 degrees yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度升到了30度。
words.en: To reach a particular standard or level; to be as good as expected.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.ex: He communicates with his friends every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和朋友交流。
words.en: To share or exchange information, news, or ideas with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 把……比作……；与……相比较（通常用于不同类事物之间的比喻或类比）
words.ex: He compared her smile to the sun.
words.ex_cn: 他把她的微笑比作太阳。
words.en: If you compare something to something else, you say that they are similar in some way.

words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他抱怨那噪音太大。
words.en: If you complain about a situation, you say that you are not satisfied with it.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于； 专心于
words.ex: He must concentrate on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须专心做作业。
words.en: To direct all your attention and effort towards a particular activity, subject, or problem.

words.ex: Congratulations on your graduation!
words.ex_cn: 祝贺你毕业！
words.en: An expression of pleasure or joy in the success or good fortune of another.

words.ex: The bridge connects the two cities.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥连接了两座城市。
words.en: If something or someone connects one thing to another, or if one thing connects to another, the two things are joined together.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.tr: phrase. 纠正错误；改正错误
words.ex: He corrects the mistakes in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他改正了作业中的错误。
words.en: To identify and rectify errors or inaccuracies.

words.ex: They cut down the old tree in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把院子里那棵老树砍倒了。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, or number of something, or to do less of something.

words.tr: phrase. 插队；不按顺序加入行列
words.ex: He cut in line at the grocery store.
words.ex_cn: 他在杂货店插队。
words.en: To move ahead of others who are waiting in line, in a way that is considered rude or unfair.

words.ex: He cut off the power during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他在风暴期间切断了电源。
words.en: To stop the supply of something, or to stop something from continuing.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 切碎；使伤心；使难过
words.ex: He cut up the apple into small pieces.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果切成了小块。
words.en: To cut something into pieces; to injure someone by making cuts in their skin; to upset someone emotionally.

words.ex: He works hard day after day.
words.ex_cn: 他日复一日地努力工作。
words.en: If something happens day after day, it happens every day without changing.

words.ex: He has a day off on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他星期五休息一天。
words.en: A day off is a day when you do not go to work or school, especially because you have a holiday or because you need or want to rest.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.ex: They decide on the color for the room.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定房间的颜色。
words.en: To choose something or someone after thinking carefully.

words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.tr: phrase. 冲洗胶卷；使胶片显影
words.ex: He takes the camera to the shop to develop a film.
words.ex_cn: 他把相机带到店里去冲洗胶卷。
words.en: To process photographic film to produce visible images.

words.tr: phrase. 因某事（病以外）而死
words.ex: He died from a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他因车祸去世。
words.en: If someone dies from a particular cause, that cause is the reason for their death.

words.ex: Many old traditions die out over time.
words.ex_cn: 许多古老的传统随着时间推移而消失。
words.en: If something dies out, it becomes less and less common and eventually disappears completely.

words.ex: This apple differs from that one in color.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个苹果在颜色上不同。
words.en: to be not the same as something else

words.ex: We will discuss the homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天讨论作业。
words.en: To discuss something means to talk about it with someone and tell each other your ideas or opinions.

words.ex: We divide the cake into six pieces.
words.ex_cn: 我们把蛋糕分成六块。
words.en: To separate or split something into parts or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 做生意；进行商业往来
words.ex: They do business with companies all over the world.
words.ex_cn: 他们与全世界的公司做生意。
words.en: To engage in commercial, industrial, or professional activities.

words.tr: phrase. 做家务；处理日常杂务
words.ex: He does chores every Saturday morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周六早上做家务。
words.en: To perform routine domestic tasks.

words.ex: Smoking can do harm to your lungs.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会对你的肺造成伤害。
words.en: To cause damage or injury to someone or something.

words.ex: Can you do me a favor and close the door?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我个忙，把门关上吗？
words.en: To do something for someone else to help them, often something that they cannot do for themselves.

words.ex: Eating vegetables does you good.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你有好处。
words.en: To be beneficial or advantageous to someone.

words.ex: He did his best in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中尽了最大努力。
words.en: To try as hard as one can to achieve something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 做一些练习；进行一些锻炼
words.ex: You should do some exercises to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 你应该做些运动以保持健康。
words.en: To engage in physical activities designed to improve fitness or health.

words.ex: She will do some shopping this afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 她今天下午要去购物。
words.en: To go to stores or shops in order to buy things.

words.ex: He does the dishes after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他饭后洗碗。
words.en: To wash the dishes; to clean the plates, glasses, and utensils used during a meal.

words.tr: 短语动词，在……方面表现良好；在……中取得成功
words.ex: He does well in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上表现很好。
words.en: To perform successfully in a particular activity or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 与...相处；忍受；处理；与…有关；需要；想做
words.ex: I don't know how to do with him; he is always quiet.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道怎么和他相处；他总是很安静。
words.en: To have a connection or relevance to a particular subject or situation.

words.ex: There are dozens of apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有很多苹果。
words.en: If you refer to dozens of things or people, you are emphasizing that there are very many of them.

words.tr: phrase. 从…得到；从…召集或选择
words.ex: He draws from his experience to solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他从自己的经验中汲取灵感来解决问题。
words.en: To take or obtain something from a particular source.

words.ex: He dreamt of flying like a bird.
words.ex_cn: 他梦见自己像鸟一样飞翔。
words.en: To think about something that you would like to happen or achieve.

words.tr: phrase. 装扮；穿上盛装；乔装打扮
words.ex: The children dress up as pirates for Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在万圣节打扮成海盗。
words.en: To wear formal or special clothes for a particular occasion or to make something or someone look more attractive by adding decorations or details.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 顺便访问；顺道拜访
words.ex: I will drop by your house after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后会去你家拜访。
words.en: To visit someone casually and usually without having arranged it before.

words.ex: He decided to drop out of the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他决定不参加比赛。
words.en: If someone drops out of a school or a course, they leave it before they have finished it.

words.ex: The river may dry up in the summer.
words.ex_cn: 这条河在夏天可能会干涸。
words.en: If something dries up or if something dries it up, it loses all its moisture and becomes completely dry.

words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.ex: He earns his living by fixing cars.
words.ex_cn: 他靠修车谋生。
words.en: To earn one's living means to make enough money to support oneself and one's family, typically through work.

words.ex: The dog ate up all the food.
words.ex_cn: 狗把所有的食物都吃光了。
words.en: To consume all of something, especially food.

words.tr: phrase. 不是…就是…；…或…；要么…要么…
words.ex: You can either stay or go.
words.ex_cn: 你要么留下，要么离开。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.tr: phrase. 鼓励某人去做某事
words.ex: My mom encourages me to study hard.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈鼓励我努力学习。
words.en: To give someone support, confidence, or hope to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 结束；告终；意外到达
words.ex: He didn't plan to stay, but he ended up sleeping there.
words.ex_cn: 他本没打算留下，但最后在那里睡了。
words.en: If you end up in a particular place or situation, you are in that place or situation after a series of events, even though you did not originally intend to be.

words.tr: 短语. 喜欢做某事；享受做某事的过程
words.ex: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在空闲时间读书。
words.en: If you enjoy something, you find pleasure and satisfaction in doing it or experiencing it.

words.ex: They enjoy themselves at the park every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每个星期天在公园里玩得很开心。
words.en: To have a good time; to experience pleasure or satisfaction in what one is doing.

words.ex: He will enter for the competition next week.
words.ex_cn: 他将报名参加下周的比赛。
words.en: To officially register or apply to participate in a competition, event, or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；包括；参与；成为...一部分
words.ex: He will enter into the room after knocking.
words.ex_cn: 他敲门后会进入房间。
words.en: To begin or become involved in an activity, agreement, or condition.

words.ex: I will go for a walk even if it rains.
words.ex_cn: 即使下雨，我也会去散步。
words.en: You use 'even if' to say that something is true or happens although something else might prevent it.

words.ex: He went out even though it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use even though to introduce a clause which gives the reason for something, but which makes the reason seem less important or significant.

words.ex: He has been happy ever since he moved to the city.
words.ex_cn: 自从他搬到城市以来，他一直很快乐。
words.en: From a particular time in the past until the present.

words.tr:
n. 交换；兑换；交易所；
v. 交换；
words.ex: They made an exchange of books.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了书籍的交换。
words.en: If you exchange something, you give it to someone and receive something else in return.

words.ex: They talked face to face instead of on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他们面对面交谈，而不是打电话。
words.en: If you meet or talk to someone face to face, you meet or talk to them directly, rather than by telephone, email, or online.

words.tr: 短语动词. 未能做某事；没有成功完成某事
words.ex: He failed to show up at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他未能出席会议。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or you do not succeed in doing it.

words.ex: He fell behind in math because he missed classes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺课而数学落下了。
words.en: To fail to keep up with others; to lag behind.

words.tr: 短语动词. 生病；患病
words.ex: He fell ill yesterday and stayed in bed.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天生病了，一直待在床上。
words.en: To become sick or to start to suffer from a disease.

words.ex: He falls in love with her when he sees her smile.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到她的微笑时，他就爱上了她。
words.en: To begin to feel romantic love for someone.

words.ex: He fell into the river by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心掉进了河里。
words.en: To fall into something means to be classified or divided into it, or to start to be in a particular state or condition.

words.ex: The book fell off the table.
words.ex_cn: 书从桌子上掉了下来。
words.en: If something falls off, it becomes detached from something to which it was attached.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 跌倒；被绊倒；翻倒
words.ex: The boy falls over and cries.
words.ex_cn: 男孩摔倒了，哭了。
words.en: To fall over means to fall to the ground or to fall down from an upright position.

words.ex: The village is far away from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄离城市很远。
words.en: At a great distance in space or time.

words.ex: The village is far away from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄离城市很远。
words.en: At, to, or from a great distance in space or time.

words.ex: Wolves feed on deer in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狼在森林里以鹿为食。
words.en: To consume something as food or to derive nourishment from it.

words.ex: I feel like eating pizza tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚想吃披萨。
words.en: To have a desire or inclination for something; to have a sensation or impression of being a certain way.

words.ex: People must fight for their rights.
words.ex_cn: 人们必须为自己的权利而斗争。
words.en: To engage in a struggle or campaign to achieve or secure something.

words.tr: phrase. 填（写）； 填满；替代
words.ex: Please fill in the blanks with the correct words.
words.ex_cn: 请用正确的单词填空。
words.en: If you fill in a form or other document requesting information, you write information in the spaces on it.

words.ex: He fills the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满水。
words.en: To make or become full.

words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.tr: 动词短语，发现某人正在做某事
words.ex: I found him reading a book when I entered the room.
words.ex_cn: 当我进入房间时，发现他正在读书。
words.en: To discover someone in the act of doing something.

words.ex: He finishes doing his homework at 8 PM.
words.ex_cn: 他晚上8点做完作业。
words.en: To complete the action or process of doing something.

words.ex: First of all, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: Before anything else; initially.

words.tr: phrase. 修理；安排； 为（某人）提供
words.ex: He will fix up his bike tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要修理他的自行车。
words.en: To repair, arrange, or organize something.

words.tr: phrase. 很长一段时间；很久
words.ex: He has been sick for a long time.
words.ex_cn: 他病了很久。
words.en: For a long time refers to a period that is lengthy or extended, often implying that the duration is significant or noteworthy.

words.ex: I will love you forever.
words.ex_cn: 我会永远爱你。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or continue forever, you mean that it will always happen or continue.

words.ex: He likes apples, for example.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，例如。
words.en: Used when you want to give a specific instance or illustration of what you are talking about.

words.ex: You can download this app for free.
words.ex_cn: 你可以免费下载这个应用。
words.en: Without payment or charge; free of cost.

words.ex: I like fruits, for instance, apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，例如苹果和香蕉。
words.en: Used to introduce an example that illustrates or supports a point being made.

words.tr: phrase. 为了乐趣；出于娱乐目的
words.ex: He reads books for pleasure.
words.ex_cn: 他读书是为了消遣。
words.en: for pleasure: for enjoyment or amusement, not for work or necessity.

words.tr: phrase. 肯定地；毫无疑问地
words.ex: He will come for sure.
words.ex_cn: 他肯定会来。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.ex: He smiled for the first time today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天第一次笑了。
words.en: If something happens for the first time, it has never happened before.

words.ex: The teacher forced the students to do their homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师强迫学生们做作业。
words.en: To compel someone to do something against their will.

words.tr: phrase. 忘记已经做过某事（表示动作已经发生但被忘记了）
words.ex: I forgot locking the door this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我忘了今天早上已经锁过门了。
words.en: If you forget doing something, you fail to remember that you have done it.

words.tr: phrase. v. 忘记去做某事（指该做的事还没做）
words.ex: I forget to do something every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上都忘记做某件事。
words.en: If you forget to do something, you do not remember to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 对……大方；慷慨地给予；不拘束地使用
words.ex_cn: 她总是坦率地表达自己的意见。
words.en: If someone is free with something such as advice or money, they give it generously and often without being asked.

words.tr: phrase. 从那时起，从那以后
words.ex: He failed the test, but from then on he studied every day.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，但从那以后他每天学习。
words.en: From a particular time in the past onwards.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents from time to time.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: If you do something from time to time, you do it occasionally but not regularly.

words.tr: 介词短语，表示从某个起点到某个终点，可用于时间、地点、数量、范围等
words.ex: The store is open from nine to five.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店从九点开到五点。
words.en: Indicating the starting point and the ending point of a range or movement.

words.tr: 短语动词. 搭便车；搭车
words.ex: I will get a ride from my brother.
words.ex_cn: 我会搭我哥哥的车。
words.en: To be transported somewhere by someone else in their vehicle.

words.tr: 短语动词. 插话；说上一句话（尤指在别人不停说话时争取发言机会）
words.ex: She was so excited that I couldn't get a word in.
words.ex_cn: 她太兴奋了，我几乎插不上话。
words.en: To manage to say something when others are talking and it is difficult to interrupt.

words.ex: They get along well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们相处得很好。
words.en: If people get along, they like each other and are friendly to each other.

words.ex: How is your project getting on?
words.ex_cn: 你的项目进展如何？
words.en: If you get on with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them. If you get on with something, you continue doing it or start doing it.

words.ex: I get along with my neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 我和我的邻居相处得很好。
words.en: If you get along with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them.

words.ex: I get on with my brother very well.
words.ex_cn: 我和我哥哥相处得很好。
words.en: To continue doing something, especially after an interruption, or to have a good relationship with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 变得恼怒；感到生气
words.ex: He gets annoyed when people are late.
words.ex_cn: 当人们迟到时，他会感到恼火。
words.en: to become slightly angry

words.ex: The thief tried to get away from the police.
words.ex_cn: 小偷试图逃脱警察。
words.en: If you get away, you succeed in leaving a place or a person's company. If you get away with something, you succeed in doing it without being caught or punished.

words.tr: phrase. 回来；取回；恢复；报复
words.ex: He will get back tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会回来。
words.en: To return to a place, condition, or activity; to recover something lost or taken away; to retaliate.

words.tr: phrase. 变得无聊；感到厌烦
words.ex: After a while, I started to get bored with the movie.
words.ex_cn: 过了一会儿，我开始对这部电影感到无聊。
words.en: get bored: to become tired and impatient because something is uninteresting.

words.tr: phrase. 着手做；开始认真做
words.ex: He got down to work after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后开始认真工作。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something seriously or with determination.

words.tr: 短语动词. 穿衣服；着装
words.ex: He gets dressed at seven o'clock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上七点穿衣服。
words.en: To put on clothes.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；到达；插话；收割；当选
words.ex: He gets in the car every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上上车。
words.en: To arrive at a place, especially after a journey.

words.ex: Don't get in the way when others are working.
words.ex_cn: 当别人工作时，不要挡道。
words.en: If something or someone gets in the way, they prevent you from doing something or make it more difficult for you to do it.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 妨碍；阻挡；干扰
words.ex: Don't let fear get in the way of your dreams.
words.ex_cn: 别让恐惧阻碍你的梦想。
words.en: To prevent someone from doing something or prevent something from happening.

words.tr: phrase. 陷入困境；遇到麻烦
words.ex: He gets into trouble when he doesn't listen to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 当他不听老师的话时，他就会陷入麻烦。
words.en: To get into trouble means to become involved in a situation where you are likely to be blamed or punished for something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 走开，消失；迷路
words.ex: He told the noisy boy to get lost.
words.ex_cn: 他让那个吵闹的男孩走开。
words.en: If you tell someone to get lost, you are telling them in a rude way to go away.

words.ex: Don't get mad at me for telling the truth.
words.ex_cn: 不要因为我讲真话而对我生气。
words.en: To become angry with someone or something.

words.ex: He is mad at his brother for breaking his toy.
words.ex_cn: 他因为弟弟弄坏了玩具而生他的气。
words.en: To feel or show anger towards someone.

words.ex: He will get married to his best friend next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月要和他最好的朋友结婚。
words.en: To enter into the state of matrimony with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 与…结婚的；与…结为夫妻的
words.ex: She has been married to him for ten years.
words.ex_cn: 她和他结婚已经十年了。
words.en: To be united to someone in matrimony.

words.ex: He gets off the bus at the school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校下车。
words.en: To leave a place, especially in order to start a journey; to remove something, especially clothing.

words.ex: How is your project getting on?
words.ex_cn: 你的项目进展如何？
words.en: If you get on with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them. If you get on with something, you continue doing it or start doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 与……相处融洽；与……关系良好
words.ex: She gets on well with her classmates.
words.ex_cn: 她和同学们相处得很好。
words.en: To have a good relationship with someone.

words.ex: He told the dog to get out.
words.ex_cn: 他让狗出去。
words.en: To leave or escape from a place or situation.

words.ex: He wants to get out of debt.
words.ex_cn: 他想摆脱债务。
words.en: To leave a place or situation; to avoid doing something that you do not want to do.

words.ex: He got over his cold last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周康复了。
words.en: To recover from something, such as an illness or a shock; to overcome a problem or difficulty.

words.ex: He is getting ready for school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为上学做准备。
words.en: To prepare oneself for something that is going to happen.

words.ex: He is ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他准备好考试了。
words.en: To be prepared or in a state of readiness for something that is expected to happen.

words.tr: 短语动词. 准备好做某事
words.ex: We get ready to go to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上都准备去上学。
words.en: To prepare oneself to undertake a particular action or task.

words.tr: 短语动词. 准备好做某事；愿意并准备好开始做某事
words.ex_cn: 她总是乐于助人。
words.en: To be prepared or willing to do something.

words.ex: He wants to get rid of the old chair.
words.ex_cn: 他想扔掉那把旧椅子。
words.en: To dispose of or remove something unwanted or undesirable.

words.tr: 短语动词. 完成某事；使某事被完成
words.ex: I get my homework done after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后把作业做完。
words.en: To complete or accomplish a task or piece of work.

words.tr: phrase. 通过；（电话）打通；度过；做完；用完
words.ex: He got through the exam with help from his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在朋友的帮助下通过了考试。
words.en: To succeed in reaching a place or a stage in a process, or to make someone understand or accept something.

words.ex: We get to the park by bus.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘公交车到公园。
words.en: If you get to a particular place, you arrive there. If you get to do something, you have the opportunity to do it. If something gets to you, it affects you emotionally.

words.ex: We get together every weekend to play basketball.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周末聚在一起打篮球。
words.en: If people get together, they meet in order to spend time with each other.

words.ex: I get up at seven o'clock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上七点起床。
words.en: To rise from bed after sleeping; to stand up; to increase in amount or level.

words.tr: 短语动词. 举办音乐会；举行演唱会
words.ex: They will give a concert next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周将举办一场音乐会。
words.en: To perform a musical concert for an audience.

words.ex: My teacher gave me good advice about studying.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师给了我关于学习的好建议。
words.en: If you give someone advice, you tell them what you think they should do in a particular situation.

words.ex: Can you give a hand with the heavy box?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮忙搬一下这个重箱子吗？
words.en: To help someone, especially by doing a particular task.

words.tr: 短语动词. 做一次演讲；发表讲话
words.ex: He will give a talk about science tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将做一场关于科学的演讲。
words.en: To deliver a formal speech or presentation to an audience.

words.tr: phrase. 赠送；分发；背叛；泄露
words.ex: He will give away his old books to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他将把他的旧书捐给图书馆。
words.en: To give something to someone without asking for payment, or to reveal something secret or private.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 归还；回馈；恢复
words.ex: He will give back the book tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会把书还回去。
words.en: If you give something back, you return it to the person who gave it to you or to the person who owns it.

words.ex: She will give birth to a baby next month.
words.ex_cn: 她下个月要生孩子。
words.en: To bring a baby or young animal into the world by birth.

words.ex: He will not give in to the bully.
words.ex_cn: 他不会向欺凌者屈服。
words.en: To agree to something that you had been opposing, especially because someone has forced or persuaded you to.

words.ex: The lamp gives off a warm light.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯发出温暖的光。
words.en: If something gives off or gives out a gas, heat, or a smell, it produces it and sends it out into the air.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；发出；发表；用尽
words.ex: He gives out books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 他把书分发给学生们。
words.en: To distribute or hand out something; to emit or produce something such as a sound or smell; to announce or make something known publicly.

words.tr: 短语动词. 为…说明理由；解释…的原因
words.ex: She had to give reasons for her sudden absence.
words.ex_cn: 她不得不解释她突然缺席的原因。
words.en: give reasons for: to explain the causes or justifications for something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 给某人打个电话
words.ex: I'll give you a call when I arrive.
words.ex_cn: 我到了就给你打电话。
words.en: To telephone someone.

words.ex: Can you give me a hand with this box?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我搬一下这个箱子吗？
words.en: To help someone with something.

words.ex: He gave up smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年戒烟了。
words.en: If you give up something, you stop doing it or having it.

words.ex: He wants to go abroad next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年出国。
words.en: To travel to a foreign country.

words.ex: Go ahead, the path is clear.
words.ex_cn: 前进吧，路是畅通的。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something without hesitation.

words.tr: phrase. 前进； 进行；赞同
words.ex: The car went along the road slowly.
words.ex_cn: 汽车缓慢地沿着路前进。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something, especially a plan or activity; to agree with or support an idea, proposal, etc.

words.ex: He will go back to his hometown next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会回他的家乡。
words.en: To return to a place or situation that you were in before.

words.tr: 短语动词. 回家；返回家中
words.ex: After work, she decided to go back home.
words.ex_cn: 下班后，她决定回家。
words.en: To return to one's place of residence.

words.ex: Time goes by quickly when you are happy.
words.ex_cn: 当你开心时，时间过得很快。
words.en: If you say that time goes by, you mean that it passes.

words.tr: phrase. 下沉；坠落；下降；被接受；传下去；被咽下
words.ex: The sun goes down in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在傍晚落下。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower place or position; to decrease in size, amount, or intensity; to be accepted or believed; to happen or take place.

words.ex: He goes fishing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末去钓鱼。
words.en: To go fishing means to spend time trying to catch fish, typically as a hobby or for relaxation.

words.tr: 短语动词. 去散步；去走一走
words.ex: He goes for a walk after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后去散步。
words.en: To go for a walk means to leave your home or workplace in order to walk somewhere, usually for pleasure or exercise.

words.ex: They go hiking every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周末去徒步。
words.en: To go hiking means to walk for long distances, especially across country or in the woods, for pleasure.

words.tr: phrase. 参加；爱好；从事；赞成
words.ex: He goes in for football every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都参加足球。
words.en: To participate in or be involved with something; to have a liking for something.

words.ex: She decided to go on a diet to lose weight before her wedding.
words.ex_cn: 她决定在婚礼前节食减肥。
words.en: To start eating less or different kinds of food in order to lose weight or for health reasons.

words.ex: We go on a picnic every spring.
words.ex_cn: 我们每年春天去野餐。
words.en: To go to a pleasant outdoor area to eat a meal.

words.ex: We have a picnic in the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去公园野餐。
words.en: To eat a meal outdoors, especially in the countryside or a park, as part of an excursion or outing.

words.tr: 短语动词. 继续做某事；接着去做另一件事
words.ex: He studied hard and went on to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，后来成为了一名医生。
words.en: To continue or proceed to do something, especially after a pause or after completing something else.

words.ex: She decided to go on with her studies despite the difficulties.
words.ex_cn: 尽管困难重重，她决定继续她的学业。
words.en: To continue doing something, especially after a pause or interruption.

words.ex: Despite the difficulties, he decided to go on doing something to improve the situation.
words.ex_cn: 尽管困难重重，他决定继续做些事情来改善局面。
words.en: To continue an activity or task without stopping.

words.ex: They go out to watch a movie on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们周末外出看电影。
words.en: To leave a place, especially one's home, for a short time, usually for a specific purpose such as entertainment or socializing.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细检查；复习；重做；转向；受欢迎
words.ex: I will go over my homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚会复习我的家庭作业。
words.en: To examine or review something carefully; to cross over something.

words.ex: She goes shopping every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 她每个星期六去购物。
words.en: To visit shops to buy goods.

words.ex: They go sightseeing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们在周末去观光。
words.en: To visit places of interest as a tourist.

words.ex: He goes to sleep at nine every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天九点睡觉。
words.en: To begin the process of sleeping.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 坚持完成；贯彻到底；把…进行到底（尤指困难或不愉快的事）
words.ex: He decided to go through with the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他决定坚持执行这个计划。
words.en: To complete or carry out something, especially something that is difficult or unpleasant.

words.tr: phrase. 伴随；与...相配；同…一致
words.ex: I will go with you to the market.
words.ex_cn: 我会和你一起去市场。
words.en: To be suitable or appropriate with something; to accompany something; to exist or occur together with something.

words.tr: phrase. 出错； 发生故障；误入歧途
words.ex: Things can go wrong if you don't follow the instructions.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不按照说明做，事情可能会出错。
words.en: If a situation or event goes wrong, it does not happen in the way you intended or expected, and often has a bad result.

words.ex: He will graduate from high school next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将从高中毕业。
words.en: To successfully complete a course of study at a school, college, or university and receive a degree or diploma.

words.tr: phrase. 新手；生手；缺乏经验的人
words.ex: He is a green hand in the field of computer programming.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机编程领域是个新手。
words.en: A person who is new to or inexperienced in a particular activity or job.

words.ex: He wants to grow up and be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他想长大后当一名医生。
words.en: To grow up means to gradually change from being a child to being an adult. This process involves physical, emotional, and intellectual development.

words.tr: had better do sth. 表示‘最好做某事’，用于建议或警告，含有轻微的劝告或威胁语气，后接动词原形
words.ex: You had better finish your homework before you go out to play.
words.ex_cn: 你最好在出去玩之前完成你的作业。
words.en: Used to advise someone that they should do something.

words.tr: had better not do sth. 表示“最好不要做某事”，用于建议或警告，暗示不做某事会带来不良后果
words.ex: You had better not go out tonight; it's supposed to rain heavily.
words.ex_cn: 你今晚最好不要出去；预计会有大雨。
words.en: Used to advise someone that they should avoid doing something because it would be unwise or could lead to undesirable consequences.

words.ex: He will hand in his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交作业。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.tr: phrase. 手拉手地；紧密地；同时发生地
words.ex: They walk hand in hand in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们手拉手在公园里散步。
words.en: If two people are hand in hand, they are holding each other's hand. If two things go hand in hand, they are closely connected and one thing causes the other.

words.ex: He will hand over the keys tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会交出钥匙。
words.en: To give something to someone else, especially because you have been ordered to do so or because it is necessary.

words.tr: 短语. 举起双手（通常表示投降或服从）
words.ex: The teacher said, 'Hands up if you know the answer.'
words.ex_cn: 老师说：‘知道答案的举手。’
words.en: Used to order someone to surrender or stop resisting by raising their hands.

words.tr: phrase. 闲逛；常去某处；挂出
words.ex: They hang out at the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们放学后在公园闲逛。
words.en: To spend time idly or casually, often with others.

words.tr: phrase. 挂断；拖延；把...挂起来
words.ex: He hung up the phone after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 争吵后，他挂断了电话。
words.en: To end a telephone conversation by breaking the connection; to suspend something from above so that it is supported only from above.

words.ex: I happened to see her at the mall yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天碰巧在商场见到了她。
words.en: If you happen to do something, you do it by chance.

words.ex_cn: 他碰巧丢了钥匙。
words.en: If something happens to someone or something, it takes place and affects them.

words.tr: phrase. 讨厌做某事；不喜欢做某事
words.ex: He hates doing the dishes after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他讨厌晚饭后洗碗。
words.en: If you hate doing something, you have a strong feeling of dislike for it and would prefer not to do it.

words.ex: He takes a bath every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上洗澡。
words.en: To wash oneself in a bathtub.

words.tr: n. 课；班级；等级；阶级；类别；
words.ex: I have math class at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 我上午九点有数学课。
words.en: A class is a group of pupils or students who are taught together.

words.ex: We have a lesson at 8 o'clock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上8点上课。
words.en: To attend or participate in a class or session where teaching or instruction is given.

words.tr: phrase. 参加一门课程；上课
words.ex: I decided to take a class in photography to improve my skills.
words.ex_cn: 我决定参加摄影课程以提高我的技能。
words.en: To enroll in or attend a course of study.

words.tr: phrase. 接受教训；吸取经验；上课
words.ex: He lost his job, and now he takes a lesson to be more careful.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了工作，现在从中吸取教训，变得更加谨慎。
words.en: To learn from an experience, especially a negative one, in order to improve or avoid similar mistakes in the future.

words.ex: They have a good time at the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园玩得很开心。
words.en: to enjoy oneself; to spend time in a pleasant way

words.ex: He has a high fever and needs to rest.
words.ex_cn: 他发高烧了，需要休息。
words.en: To suffer from a significantly elevated body temperature, typically as a symptom of illness.

words.ex: He has got a high fever and needs to rest.
words.ex_cn: 他发高烧了，需要休息。
words.en: To have a body temperature that is significantly higher than normal, often as a symptom of an illness.

words.ex: I will have a look at your homework.
words.ex_cn: 我会看一下你的作业。
words.en: To direct one's gaze towards something in order to see it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 开会；举行会议
words.ex: They have a meeting every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周一都有个会议。
words.en: To gather people together for discussion or decision-making.

words.tr: 短语动词，指有意图、打算或倾向于做某事；有某种想法或意愿
words.ex: I have a mind to start a new project this year.
words.ex_cn: v. 我今年有意开始一个新项目。
words.en: To have a particular intention or plan.

words.tr: phrase. 有心想做某事，常用于表达“很想做某事（尤指出于愤怒或决心）”，如 'I have a good mind to tell him off.'
words.ex: I have a good mind to tell him exactly what I think.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 我很想告诉他我的真实想法。
words.en: To be strongly inclined to do something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 休息一下；停下来歇一会儿
words.ex: After running, he has a rest under the tree.
words.ex_cn: 跑步后，他在树下休息一下。
words.en: To take a break or relax, especially after a period of work or activity.

words.tr: 玩得高兴，过得快活; 耍笑; 玩耍
words.ex: They have fun playing soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们放学后踢足球很开心。
words.en: to enjoy oneself; to experience pleasure and enjoyment

words.tr: phrase. 不知道；不清楚；不了解
words.ex: I have no idea where the bus stop is.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道公交车站在哪里。
words.en: If you have no idea about something, you do not know anything about it or you have no understanding of it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 没有时间做某事
words.ex: I have no time to do my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我没有时间做作业。
words.en: To be too busy to have the opportunity or time to do something.

words.ex: I have to go to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天必须去上学。
words.en: If you have to do something, it is necessary for you to do it.

words.ex: I have off work on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我周末不上班。
words.en: To take a day or time off from work or school; to be on vacation or leave.

words.tr: 短语. 做某事有困难
words.ex: He has trouble doing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做作业有困难。
words.en: If you have trouble doing something, you find it difficult to do.

words.ex: I haven't heard from my friend for a week.
words.ex_cn: 我一周没有收到我朋友的消息了。
words.en: to receive communication from someone

words.ex: I have never heard of that song before.
words.ex_cn: 我以前从未听说过那首歌。
words.en: To become aware of something through hearing about it from someone else.

words.ex: I just heard about the new park in town.
words.ex_cn: 我刚刚听说了镇上的新公园。
words.en: To become aware of something through being told about it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 帮忙做某事；帮助完成某事
words.ex: Can you help me do my homework?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我做作业吗？
words.en: help do sth.: to assist in performing an action or task.

words.tr: 短语动词. 帮助做某事
words.ex: She often helps to do the dishes after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她经常在晚餐后帮忙洗碗。
words.en: To assist in doing something; to make it easier for someone to do something by offering one's services or resources.

words.tr: phrase. v. 自取所需；随意享用（食物或饮料）
words.ex: Please help yourself to some cookies on the table.
words.ex_cn: 请随便吃些桌上的饼干。
words.en: To serve oneself with food or drink without waiting to be served by someone else.

words.ex: He looks here and there for his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他到处找他的钥匙。
words.en: in various places; scattered around

words.tr: phrase. 举行运动会；举办体育比赛
words.ex: The school will hold a sports meeting next week.
words.ex_cn: 学校下周将举行运动会。
words.en: To organize and conduct a sports event or competition.

words.tr: phrase. 抓紧不放；继续；不挂断；坚持
words.ex: Hold on the rope tightly!
words.ex_cn: 紧紧抓住绳子！
words.en: To continue to do something or to wait for a short time.

words.tr: phrase. 紧紧抓住；坚持；保持
words.ex: Please hold on to the handrail when the bus starts.
words.ex_cn: 当公共汽车启动时，请抓紧扶手。
words.en: To hold on to something means to keep it in your possession or to not let it go, often because it is valuable or important to you.

words.ex: He holds his breath when he waits for the result.
words.ex_cn: 他等待结果时屏住呼吸。
words.en: If you hold your breath, you make yourself stop breathing for a moment, usually because you are waiting for something to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；支撑；继续下去；推举；阻挡；拦截；持械抢劫
words.ex: He held up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To hold something up means to keep it in a high position so that it does not fall or to support it. It can also mean to delay or stop the progress of something or someone, or to rob someone using violence or the threat of violence.

words.ex: I hope to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我希望能去公园玩。
words.en: If you hope to do something, you want to do it and intend to do it if you can.

words.ex: How far is it from here to the station?
words.ex_cn: 从这里到车站有多远？
words.en: Used to ask about the distance to a place or the extent or degree to which something happens or is true.

words.ex: How long does it take to walk to school?
words.ex_cn: 走路去学校要多久？
words.en: used to ask about the duration of time

words.tr: 疑问词组，用于询问数量，表示“多少”
words.ex: How many apples do you have?
words.ex_cn: 你有多少个苹果？
words.en: used to ask about the number of something

words.ex: How often do you go to the park?
words.ex_cn: 你多久去一次公园？
words.en: Used to ask about the frequency of an event or action.

words.tr: 疑问短语，用于询问年龄，中文意思为“多大年纪；几岁”
words.ex: How old is your brother?
words.ex_cn: 你弟弟多大了？
words.en: How old is a question asking for someone's age or the age of an object.

words.ex: How soon can you finish your homework?
words.ex_cn: 你多久能完成作业？
words.en: used to ask about the time something will take or happen

words.ex: Hundreds of students came to the event.
words.ex_cn: 有数百名学生参加了这个活动。
words.en: Used to emphasize a large but indefinite number of things or people.

words.ex: Hurry up, or we will miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则我们会错过公交车。
words.en: If you tell someone to hurry up, you are telling them to do something more quickly than they were doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 如果不；否则；要是不；即使不
words.ex: Hurry up, if not you will miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 快点，如果不的话你会错过公交车。
words.en: Used to introduce a condition that must be met for the main clause to occur; otherwise, the main clause does not occur.

words.ex: If only I had more time, I would finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 要是我有更多时间，我就能完成作业了。
words.en: used to express a wish that something had happened differently or that something would happen

words.ex: It is possible to learn English quickly.
words.ex_cn: 快速学会英语是可能的。
words.en: If something is possible, it can be done or achieved.

words.ex: He is in a hurry to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他赶着去赶公交车。
words.en: If you are in a hurry, you are doing something quickly because you do not have much time.

words.tr: phrase. 低声地；小声地；压低声音地
words.ex: He spoke in a low voice so no one else could hear.
words.ex_cn: 他低声说话，以免别人听见。
words.en: Speaking or singing with a low volume or pitch.

words.ex: He spoke in a loud voice to make sure everyone could hear him.
words.ex_cn: 他大声说话，以确保每个人都能听到。
words.en: In a manner that is easily audible due to high volume.
