words.tr: phrase. 以疲惫的声音；用疲倦的嗓音
words.ex: She spoke in a tired voice, barely able to muster the energy to continue.
words.ex_cn: 她用疲倦的声音说话，几乎没有力气继续下去。
words.en: in a tired voice: speaking in a tone that sounds weary or lacking energy.

words.tr: phrase. 混乱；一团糟；陷于窘境
words.ex: His room is in a mess.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间乱七八糟。
words.en: If something is in a mess, it is in a state of confusion or disorder.

words.ex: I will do it in a minute.
words.ex_cn: 我马上做。
words.en: Used to indicate that something will happen very soon.

words.ex: He is lazy, in a word.
words.ex_cn: 总之，他很懒。
words.en: used to give a summary or to introduce a conclusion

words.ex: He likes apples. In addition, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果。另外，他喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use in addition when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.ex: He has ten apples in all.
words.ex_cn: 他一共有十个苹果。
words.en: You use in all to emphasize that something is the total amount or number involved.

words.tr: phrase. 用另一种方式；换句话说；以不同的方法
words.ex: He explained the concept in another way to make it clearer.
words.ex_cn: 他用另一种方式解释了这个概念，使其更加清晰。
words.en: In a different manner or from a different perspective.

words.ex: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
words.ex_cn: 带把伞，以防下雨。
words.en: used to describe a situation where you do something in order to be prepared for a possible future event

words.ex: He is in charge of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他负责这个教室。
words.en: Having control over or responsibility for someone or something.

words.ex: They have nothing in common.
words.ex_cn: 他们没有什么共同点。
words.en: If two or more people have something in common, they share the same interests or experiences.

words.ex: The cat is in danger from the big dog.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫正处在大狗的危险中。
words.en: At risk of harm, injury, or loss.

words.tr: phrase. 用英语；在英语方面
words.ex: Can you say it in english?
words.ex_cn: 你能用英语说一下吗？
words.en: In the language that originated in England and is now used in many countries.

words.ex: He says he likes sports, but in fact, he hates them.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢运动，但事实上，他讨厌它们。
words.en: You use in fact to emphasize that something is true, especially when it contradicts what has just been said or might be expected.

words.ex: He is in favor of eating vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他赞成吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you are in favor of something, you support it or agree with it.

words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子前面。
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.tr: phrase. 通常；大体上；一般而言
words.ex: In general, he likes to eat fruit.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他喜欢吃水果。
words.en: Usually; in most cases.

words.tr: phrase. 成群地；以小组形式；分组地
words.ex: The students worked in groups to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 学生们以小组形式合作解决问题。
words.en: In groups refers to doing something together with others as part of a group or team.

words.ex: He is in hospital recovering from surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他住院接受手术后的康复治疗。
words.en: Being in a hospital as a patient.

words.tr: phrase. 处于饥饿状态；因饥饿而…
words.ex: The refugees are living in hunger and despair.
words.ex_cn: 难民们生活在饥饿和绝望之中。
words.en: in hunger: suffering from a need for food; feeling hungry.

words.ex: He finished his homework in no time.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就完成了作业。
words.en: Very quickly or soon.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人五十多岁时
words.ex: He started a new job in his fifties.
words.ex_cn: 他在五十多岁时开始了一份新工作。
words.en: When someone is in their fifties, they are aged between 50 and 59.

words.ex: In my opinion, the movie is very good.
words.ex_cn: 在我看来，这部电影非常好。
words.en: Used to express someone's personal view or belief about something.

words.tr: phrase. 按次序的；合乎程序的；井然有序
words.ex: Please line up in order.
words.ex_cn: 请按次序排队。
words.en: In the correct sequence or arrangement; appropriate or required by the circumstances.

words.ex: He wakes up early in order to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶上公交车。
words.en: with the purpose of achieving something

words.ex: He sings in public every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都在公共场合唱歌。
words.en: In a way that can be seen or heard by other people; openly.

words.tr: phrase. 穿红色衣服；用红色；以红色显示
words.ex: The girl is in red at the party.
words.ex_cn: 那个女孩在派对上穿红色衣服。
words.en: in red: wearing red clothes or having a red colour.

words.ex: I helped him, and he gave me a gift in return.
words.ex_cn: 我帮了他，他送了我一份礼物作为回报。
words.en: If you do something in return for what someone else has done for you, you do it because they did that thing for you.

words.tr: phrase. 安全地；平安地；处于安全状态
words.ex: The children were playing in safety.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在安全地玩耍。
words.en: In safety refers to being free from harm or danger, ensuring that someone or something is protected and secure.

words.ex: He is in search of a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在寻找一份新工作。
words.en: If you are in search of something, you are looking for it.

words.ex: In short, he likes pizza.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，他喜欢披萨。
words.en: used to introduce a summary of something that has just been said or to give a brief statement of the main points.

words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.tr: phrase. 时髦地；有气派地；豪华地
words.ex: She dresses in style and always catches everyone's attention.
words.ex_cn: 她的穿着别具风格，总是能吸引所有人的注意。
words.en: If something is in style, it is fashionable or popular at a particular time.

words.ex: He looked at me in surprise.
words.ex_cn: 他惊讶地看着我。
words.en: In a manner that shows you are surprised or startled by something.

words.tr: phrase. 在20世纪70年代；在1970年代
words.ex: In the 1970s, disco music became extremely popular.
words.ex_cn: 在20世纪70年代，迪斯科音乐变得非常流行。
words.en: in the 1970s: during the decade from 1970 to 1979.

words.tr: phrase. 在黑暗中；秘密地；不知道地
words.ex: The children played in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在黑暗中玩耍。
words.en: If you are in the dark about something, you do not know anything about it.

words.tr: phrase. 在白天；在日间；在过去（某段时期）
words.ex: He works hard in the day and sleeps at night.
words.ex_cn: 他白天努力工作，晚上睡觉。
words.en: in the day: during the daytime; in the past, especially in former times.

words.ex: In the end, he chose to go home.
words.ex_cn: 最后，他选择回家。
words.en: finally, after everything has been considered or done

words.tr: phrase. 以……的形式；呈……形状；以……方式
words.ex: The answer is in the form of a number.
words.ex_cn: 答案是以数字的形式给出的。
words.en: used to indicate the way in which something is done or presented

words.ex: I will go to college in the future.
words.ex_cn: 我将来会去上大学。
words.en: at a time after the present

words.ex: She is in the habit of drinking a cup of coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 她习惯于每天早上喝一杯咖啡。
words.en: Being accustomed to doing something regularly or routinely.

words.ex: He stopped walking in the middle of the road.
words.ex_cn: 他在路中间停了下来。
words.en: If you are in the middle of doing something, you are busy doing it.

words.ex: The children play in the open air every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天下午在户外玩耍。
words.en: Outdoors; not inside a building.

words.ex: He played soccer in the past.
words.ex_cn: 他过去踢足球。
words.en: At a time before the present; in earlier times.

words.ex: In the past few years, many people have bought electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 在过去几年里，很多人买了电动车。
words.en: During the recent years

words.ex: She solved the problem in this way.
words.ex_cn: 她这样解决了问题。
words.en: By means of this method or manner.

words.ex: He arrived in time for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他赶上了公交车。
words.en: If you say that something will happen in time or given time, you mean that it will happen eventually, after a lot of time has passed.

words.ex: He is in trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而陷入麻烦。
words.en: In a situation that is difficult or dangerous.

words.tr: phrase. 依次；轮流；结果；反过来
words.ex: The students spoke in turn to answer the teacher's question.
words.ex_cn: 学生们依次回答老师的问题。
words.en: You use in turn to refer to actions or events that are in a sequence one after the other, especially because one causes the other.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: In place of someone or something else.

words.ex: Can you join in the game?
words.ex_cn: 你能加入这个游戏吗？
words.en: If you join in an activity, you take part in it or become involved in it.

words.tr: phrase. 加入某人；与某人一起做某事；和某人汇合
words.ex: Why don't you join us for dinner?
words.ex_cn: 你为什么不和我们一起吃晚饭？
words.en: To become a member of a group or to participate in an activity with someone.

words.ex: He decided to join the army after high school.
words.ex_cn: 高中毕业后，他决定参军。
words.en: join the army: to become a soldier by enlisting in the military.

words.tr: phrase. 跳下；跳离；开始；启动
words.ex: The race will jump off at noon.
words.ex_cn: 比赛将于中午开始。
words.en: To leap or spring off a surface or object, often as a means of starting a race or competition.

words.ex: He waited for a moment before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他等了一会儿才开口。
words.en: A moment is a very short period of time.

words.ex: He called me just now.
words.ex_cn: 他刚才给我打了电话。
words.en: A very short time ago.

words.tr: phrase. 就在那时；正当那时
words.ex: He was walking home, just then the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 他正走在回家的路上，就在那时电话响了。
words.en: At exactly that moment.

words.ex: She keeps a diary every night before bed.
words.ex_cn: 她每天晚上睡觉前都写日记。
words.en: To regularly record personal experiences, thoughts, or feelings in a diary.

words.tr: phrase. 继续做某事；持续不断地做某事
words.ex: He keeps doing his homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都继续做作业。
words.en: to continue an action or state without stopping

words.ex: He runs every morning to keep fit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步以保持健康。
words.en: To maintain one's health and physical condition through regular exercise and a healthy diet.

words.ex: He practices Tai Chi every morning to keep in good health.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习太极拳以养生。
words.en: To maintain a state of good physical and mental condition.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人保持健康；维持某人的良好健康状态
words.ex: Regular exercise and a balanced diet can help keep sb. in good health.
words.ex_cn: 定期锻炼和均衡饮食有助于保持某人健康。
words.en: To maintain someone's health in a good condition.

words.ex: Keep in mind that the bus leaves at 6 o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 记住，公交车六点发车。
words.en: To remember or not forget something.

words.ex: I keep in touch with my friend by texting.
words.ex_cn: 我通过发短信和朋友保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone.

words.ex: Keep off the grass.
words.ex_cn: 别踩草坪。
words.en: To avoid touching, stepping on, or coming into contact with something; to prevent someone or something from coming near or touching something.

words.tr: phrase. 不许入内； 挡在外面
words.ex: The fence is to keep out animals.
words.ex_cn: 这道篱笆是用来挡动物的。
words.en: To prevent someone or something from entering a place.

words.tr: phrase. 保持安静；默不作声；保密
words.ex: Please keep quiet during the movie.
words.ex_cn: 请在电影放映期间保持肃静。
words.en: To remain silent or make little noise.

words.tr: phrase. 保守秘密；不泄露机密
words.ex: Good friends can keep secrets.
words.ex_cn: 好朋友能保守秘密。
words.en: To not tell other people information that is meant to be private or confidential.

words.tr: phrase. 保守秘密；守口如瓶
words.ex: He can keep a secret very well.
words.ex_cn: 他很能保守秘密。
words.en: To keep a secret means to not tell anyone else about it.

words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To keep up with something means to manage to do or have as much of it as is necessary or desirable, or to move at the same speed as someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止……做某事；使……免于做某事
words.ex: The heavy rain kept us from going out.
words.ex_cn: 大雨使我们无法外出。
words.en: To prevent someone from doing something.

words.ex: I kind of like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 我有点喜欢披萨。
words.en: To some extent; somewhat.

words.ex: He heard someone knock at the door.
words.ex_cn: 他听到有人敲门。
words.en: To tap or strike a door to attract attention.

words.ex: He knocks on the door before entering.
words.ex_cn: 他进入前敲门。
words.en: To strike a door with the knuckles, a hard object, etc., in order to attract attention or gain entry.

words.tr: phrase. 撞上；偶然遇见；把…灌输给
words.ex: He knock into the table and spilled the water.
words.ex_cn: 他撞到了桌子，把水弄洒了。
words.en: To accidentally hit or collide with someone or something, or to meet someone by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 撞倒；打翻；抢劫（商店等）；使震惊
words.ex: The dog knocked over the vase and broke it.
words.ex_cn: 狗把花瓶撞倒了，打碎了。
words.en: To cause something to fall or topple by striking it.

words.ex: I know about cats and dogs.
words.ex_cn: 我知道关于猫和狗的事情。
words.en: To have information or understanding about something.

words.ex: He was tired, but he will study later on.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，但他稍后会学习。
words.en: At a time in the future; after the time you are talking about.

words.ex: They laugh at his funny hat.
words.ex_cn: 他们因他的滑稽帽子而发笑。
words.en: To laugh at someone or something means to mock or ridicule them, often in a way that is not kind.

words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.ex: We learn about animals in science class.
words.ex_cn: 我们在科学课上了解动物。
words.en: To gain knowledge or information about a particular subject or topic.

words.ex: The students learn the poem by heart.
words.ex_cn: 学生们把这首诗背熟了。
words.en: To memorize something thoroughly so that it can be recited or written without hesitation.

words.ex: We should learn from our mistakes and not repeat them.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该从错误中学习，不再重蹈覆辙。
words.en: To gain knowledge or skill by studying, practicing, being taught, or experiencing something.

words.ex: Please leave a message if he is not available.
words.ex_cn: 如果他不在，请留个话。
words.en: If you leave a message, you leave a piece of information for someone, especially when you cannot speak to them directly.

words.tr: phrase. 不打扰；不干涉；让…独自待着
words.ex: Please leave me alone when I am studying.
words.ex_cn: 当我学习时，请不要打扰我。
words.en: To allow someone or something to remain undisturbed or not to interfere with them.

words.ex: He leaves for work at 7 a.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上七点出发去上班。
words.en: To depart from a place to go to another.

words.tr: phrase. 借给；贷给；把…借予；有助于；促成
words.ex: He will lend his book to me tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会把他的书借给我。
words.en: To give something to someone for a period of time, expecting it to be returned; to contribute or add (a quality) to something.

words.tr: phrase. 越来越少；越来越少地；逐渐减少地
words.ex: He has less and less time to play video games.
words.ex_cn: 他玩电子游戏的时间越来越少。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is decreasing in quantity or degree over time.

words.ex: He has less than five apples.
words.ex_cn: 他不到五个苹果。
words.en: If something is less than a particular amount, it is not as much as that amount.

words.tr: phrase. 使失望；辜负；放下；降低
words.ex: He let down his team by missing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他因为没参加比赛而让队友失望了。
words.en: To fail to support or help someone as they had hoped or expected.

words.ex: He let out a loud scream.
words.ex_cn: 他大喊了一声。
words.en: To allow something to escape or be released; to reveal something that was supposed to be kept secret; to rent out property.

words.tr: phrase. 躺下；接受；忍受；逃避（职责）
words.ex: He lies down after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后躺下。
words.en: To recline or rest in a horizontal position.

words.ex: He lies in bed on Sunday mornings.
words.ex_cn: 他在周日早上睡懒觉。
words.en: To be the main or most important part of something; to stay in bed longer than usual in the morning.

words.ex: The candles light up the room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛点亮了房间。
words.en: To make something bright or to start to burn.

words.ex: The children line up to enter the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们排队进入教室。
words.en: To arrange people or things in a row or to arrange for an event or activity to happen.

words.ex: He listens to music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听音乐。
words.en: To pay attention to someone or something in order to hear what is being said, sung, played, etc.

words.ex: They live in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一栋小房子里。
words.en: To reside or exist within a particular place or environment.

words.tr: phrase. 继续生存； 以...为主食, 靠...生活
words.ex: The old man lives on small donations from neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人靠邻居们的小额捐款继续生存。
words.en: To continue to exist or be remembered; to have a particular type of food or income as one's main source of sustenance.

words.ex: He left home long before the sun rose.
words.ex_cn: 太阳升起之前很久，他就离开了家。
words.en: At a time earlier than a specified event or period.

words.ex: He longs for his hometown.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望他的家乡。
words.en: To have a strong wish or desire for something.

words.ex: She looks after her little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To take care of someone or something.

words.ex: He looks around the room to find his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他环顾房间找他的钥匙。
words.en: To direct one's gaze in various directions; to explore or examine a place or situation.

words.ex: He looks at the picture carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细地看着这幅画。
words.en: To direct your eyes towards someone or something so that you can see them.

words.ex: He looks down on people who work hard.
words.ex_cn: 他瞧不起努力工作的人。
words.en: To regard someone or something as inferior or unworthy of respect.

words.ex: He looks for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search for something or someone.

words.ex: I look forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待着周末。
words.en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

words.tr: phrase. 调查；研究；观察；检查
words.ex: The police will look into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查这起事故。
words.en: If you look into a problem or matter, you investigate it or examine it.

words.ex: He looks like his father.
words.ex_cn: 他看起来像他的父亲。
words.en: To resemble or seem similar to someone or something in appearance.

words.ex: Look out the window to see the birds.
words.ex_cn: 往窗外看，看看那些鸟。
words.en: To be vigilant or cautious.

words.ex: He likes to look out of the window in class.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在上课时往窗外看。
words.en: To direct one's gaze out of something (such as a window) to see what is outside.

words.ex: I look up the word in the dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在字典里查这个词。
words.en: If you look up a fact or a piece of information, you find it by looking in something such as a reference book or a list.

words.tr: phrase. 察看；检查；翻阅；原谅；从...上面看
words.ex: He will look over his homework before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡觉前会检查一下作业。
words.en: To examine or inspect something quickly or casually.

words.ex: He looked through the book quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速翻阅了那本书。
words.en: To look through something means to examine or read it quickly or casually.

words.ex: He loses hope when he cannot find a job.
words.ex_cn: 当他找不到工作时，他就失去了希望。
words.en: To cease to believe that something desired might happen or be possible.

words.ex: He loses his job because he is often late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为经常迟到而丢了工作。
words.en: To be dismissed from one's employment.

words.ex: He lost his life in the car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在车祸中丧生了。
words.en: To die, especially in a sudden or violent way.

words.ex: He wants to lose weight by eating less and walking more.
words.ex_cn: 他想通过少吃多走来减肥。
words.en: To reduce one's body weight intentionally.

words.ex: There are lots of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.ex: He wants to major in biology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学主修生物学。
words.en: To specialize in a particular subject or field of study at a college or university.

words.tr: phrase. 做出选择；作出抉择
words.ex: He must make a choice today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天必须做出选择。
words.en: To decide between two or more possibilities.

words.ex: He makes a decision quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快做出决定。
words.en: To choose between options after consideration; to make up one's mind.

words.ex: They want to make a film about a talking dog.
words.ex_cn: 他们想拍一部关于会说话的狗的电影。
words.en: To produce a motion picture, typically involving directing, acting, and editing.

words.ex: He made a fire to keep warm.
words.ex_cn: 他生了一堆火来取暖。
words.en: To start a fire, especially for heating or cooking.

words.ex: He makes a living by selling vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他靠卖蔬菜谋生。
words.en: To earn enough money to support oneself.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.ex: Make a note of the meeting time.
words.ex_cn: 把会议时间记下来。
words.en: To write down something so that you will remember it.

words.ex: He makes notes of everything the teacher says.
words.ex_cn: 他把老师说的每件事都做笔记。
words.en: To write down or record important information or details.

words.ex: I need to make a phone call to my mom.
words.ex_cn: v. 我需要给我妈妈打个电话。
words.en: To contact someone by telephone.

words.tr: phrase. 提出建议；给出建议
words.ex: He makes a suggestion to take a break.
words.ex_cn: 他建议休息一下。
words.en: To offer an idea or plan for consideration.

words.tr: phrase. 对……做出贡献；为……作出贡献；有助于……
words.ex: Many scientists make contributions to the development of new medicines.
words.ex_cn: 许多科学家为新药的研发做出了贡献。
words.en: To give or supply in common with others; give to a common fund or for a common purpose.

words.ex: The boy likes to make faces at his sister.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩喜欢对他的妹妹做鬼脸。
words.en: To make faces means to contort one's face in an exaggerated or comical way, often to express emotions or to amuse others.

words.ex: He wants to make friends with the new student.
words.ex_cn: 他想和新同学交朋友。
words.en: To become friendly with someone, or to start a friendship with them.

words.ex: They make fun of him for wearing old shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他穿旧鞋子而取笑他。
words.en: To tease, laugh at, or joke about someone in a way that is either playful or mocking.

words.tr: phrase. 及时到达；达到预定目标
words.ex: We need to leave now to make it to the train on time.
words.ex_cn: 我们现在必须出发，才能及时赶到火车。
words.en: To succeed in arriving at a place or achieving a goal.

words.ex: He makes money by selling cakes.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卖蛋糕赚钱。
words.en: To earn or obtain money through work, investment, or other means.

words.tr: phrase. 前往；朝…走去；费力地走到
words.ex: He makes his way to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行去学校。
words.en: To go or travel towards a particular place or in a particular direction.

words.tr: phrase. 朝…方向前进；向…走去；努力接近（某目标）
words.ex: He make one's way towards the door.
words.ex_cn: 他向门口走去。
words.en: To move or travel in the direction of a particular place.

words.tr: phrase. 穿过；费力地通过；设法完成；在…中前进
words.ex: He is making his way through the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他正在穿过人群。
words.en: To move through a place or a group of people, especially when it is difficult or crowded.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；辨认出；书写；进展；设法应付；亲热
words.ex: I can't make out the words in this small print.
words.ex_cn: 我看不清这些小字。
words.en: to manage to see, hear, or understand someone or something with difficulty

words.tr: phrase. 取得进步；取得进展
words.ex: He is making progress in his English speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他在英语口语方面正在取得进步。
words.en: To advance or develop towards a better, more complete, or more modern state.

words.tr: phrase. 确保；确定；核实；查明
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前确保锁好门。
words.en: To make certain that something is done or happens.

words.ex: He makes the bed every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都整理床铺。
words.en: To arrange the sheets, blankets, and pillows on a bed neatly after it has been slept in.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.ex: He made up his mind to quit smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他下定决心戒烟。
words.en: To decide something after considering it carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 设法做成某事；成功完成某事
words.ex: He manages to do his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都能设法完成作业。
words.en: To succeed in doing something, especially something that requires effort or skill.

words.tr: phrase. 与某人结婚；娶某人；嫁某人
words.ex: She decided to marry her childhood sweetheart.
words.ex_cn: 她决定与她的青梅竹马结婚。
words.en: To marry someone means to become their husband or wife in a legal or religious ceremony.

words.tr: phrase. 与…匹配；与…相配；使与…一致
words.ex: The curtains don't match with the paint color.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘与油漆的颜色不搭配。
words.en: To be compatible or suitable with something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 将…与…配对；使…与…匹配；把…和…对应起来
words.ex: Please match the words with the pictures.
words.ex_cn: 请把单词和图片配对。
words.en: To pair or combine one thing with another in a way that is appropriate or complementary.

words.tr: phrase. 打算做某事；有意做某事；故意做某事
words.ex: I didn't mean to hurt you.
words.ex_cn: 我并不是有意要伤害你。
words.en: If you mean to do something, you intend or plan to do it.

words.ex: The new policy is designed to meet the needs of all citizens.
words.ex_cn: 新政策旨在满足所有公民的需求。
words.en: To fulfill or satisfy the requirements or desires of someone or something.

words.ex: I met with an old friend at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市偶遇了一位老朋友。
words.en: to experience or encounter something, especially something that is unexpected or unpleasant; to have a meeting with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 成百万的；许许多多的
words.ex: Millions of people watch the game every year.
words.ex_cn: 每年有数百万人观看这场比赛。
words.en: used to emphasize a very large number of things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 把…看错成；把…误解成
words.ex: He often mistakes the cat for the dog.
words.ex_cn: 他经常把猫错认成狗。
words.en: To confuse someone or something with another person or thing.

words.ex: Don't mix up the red and blue paints.
words.ex_cn: 别把红色和蓝色的颜料弄混了。
words.en: To confuse or mistake one thing for another.

words.ex: He mops the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上拖地。
words.en: To clean the floor with a mop.

words.ex: More and more people use phones to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 越来越多的人用手机学英语。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is increasing in quantity or degree over time.

words.ex: He is more or less ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他差不多准备好考试了。
words.en: To a certain extent; approximately.

words.ex: He has more than three books.
words.ex_cn: 他有三本书以上。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is greater in amount, degree, or number than something else or than expected.

words.tr:
adv. 最；
pron. 大部分；
adj. 最多的；大多数的；
words.ex: He is most tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后最累。
words.en: You use most to refer to the majority of a group of things or people or the largest part of something.

words.tr: phrase. 搬到；迁移到；移动到；转移到
words.ex: They want to move to a new house next month.
words.ex_cn: 他们想下个月搬到一个新房子。
words.en: To relocate to a different place or position.

words.tr: phrase. 并驾齐驱；不分上下；势均力敌
words.ex: The two runners were neck and neck as they approached the finish line.
words.ex_cn: 两名跑者在接近终点线时并驾齐驱。
words.en: If two competitors are neck and neck, they are level with each other and have an equal chance of winning.

words.ex: Neither Tom nor Anna likes coffee.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆和安娜都不喜欢咖啡。
words.en: used to introduce two or more negative possibilities, indicating that none of them is true or will happen

words.tr: phrase. 某人也不；某人同样不（用于否定句的倒装，表示前面否定的情况同样适用于后者）
words.ex: I don't like coffee. Neither does my brother.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢咖啡，我弟弟也不喜欢。
words.en: Used to say that someone else also does not do something.

words.tr: phrase. 以前从未；前所未有地
words.ex: This is the best performance we've seen never before.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们以前从未见过的最佳表现。
words.en: At no previous time; on no previous occasion.

words.ex: Never mind the mistake, let's keep going.
words.ex_cn: 别管那个错误了，我们继续吧。
words.en: You say 'never mind' when you are emphasizing that something is not serious or important, especially when someone is upset about it or you are telling them not to worry about it.

words.ex: The book is next to the pen.
words.ex_cn: 书在笔旁边。
words.en: Adjacent to; at the side of.

words.tr: phrase. 别无选择；只能；不得不
words.ex: I had no choice but to accept the offer.
words.ex_cn: 我别无选择，只能接受这个提议。
words.en: Having no alternative other than to do something.

words.ex: He no longer plays soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他不再踢足球了。
words.en: If something is no longer the case, it is not the case now, although it was the case in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 无论怎样；无论如何；不管怎样
words.ex: No matter how hard he tries, he cannot solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 无论他多么努力，都解不出这道题。
words.en: Regardless of the degree or extent of something.

words.ex: No wonder he is tired, he worked all night.
words.ex_cn: 难怪他累了，他整晚都在工作。
words.en: It is not surprising that something is the case.

words.ex: I do not like spinach at all.
words.ex_cn: 我一点也不喜欢菠菜。
words.en: Used to emphasize that you are not in the least bit tired, interested, etc.

words.ex: Not only does he play the piano, but also he sings well.
words.ex_cn: 他不仅会弹钢琴，而且唱得也很好。
words.en: Used to emphasize that two things are true, especially when this is surprising or impressive.

words.tr: phrase. 一点也不；丝毫不；完全不
words.ex: I am not tired in the slightest.
words.ex_cn: 我一点也不累。
words.en: Not at all; not even a little bit.

words.ex: He did not go to bed until his mother came home.
words.ex_cn: 他直到妈妈回家才去睡觉。
words.en: Used to indicate that something does not happen before a certain point in time or before a certain event occurs.

words.ex: He has nothing but praise for his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他对老师只有赞美。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is only what you say it is and nothing more

words.tr:
n. 注意；通知；
v. 注意；留心；通知；
words.ex: He gave a notice about the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他发布了关于会议的通知。
words.en: If you notice something or someone, you become aware of them.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents now and then.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.ex: Now that it is sunny, we can go outside.
words.ex_cn: 既然天晴了，我们可以出去了。
words.en: Used to introduce a reason or explanation, often implying that the situation has changed.

words.ex: Of course, I will help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 当然，我会帮你做作业。
words.en: Used to express agreement or to indicate that something is expected or obvious.

words.tr: phrase. 属于自己的；自己专有的
words.ex: Every child should have a room of his own.
words.ex_cn: 每个孩子都应该有自己的房间。
words.en: belonging to oneself and no one else

words.tr: phrase. 正在访问（某地）；到…参观
words.ex: She is on a visit to her grandparents in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 她正在乡下看望她的祖父母。
words.en: During the process of visiting a place or someone.

words.ex: On average, children sleep 10 hours a night.
words.ex_cn: 平均而言，儿童每天睡10个小时。
words.en: If you say that something is true on average, you mean that it is generally the case.

words.ex: The captain asked the crew to get on board.
words.ex_cn: 船长让船员们上船。
words.en: On board means to be on a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle.

words.ex: He is traveling on business.
words.ex_cn: 他出差。
words.en: If someone is on business, they are away from their usual place of work because they are doing something connected with their job.

words.ex: The paintings are on display in the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这些画在博物馆里展出。
words.en: If something is on display, it is arranged for people to look at in a public place.

words.tr: phrase. 值班的；当值的；值勤的；在上班
words.ex: The nurse is on duty tonight.
words.ex_cn: 护士今晚在值班。
words.en: If someone is on duty, they are working at a particular time.

words.ex: What on earth are you doing?
words.ex_cn: 你到底在干什么？
words.en: Used for emphasis in questions to express surprise or confusion.

words.ex: The building was on fire, and people were trying to escape.
words.ex_cn: 大楼着火了，人们正在试图逃离。
words.en: If something is on fire, it is burning and being damaged or destroyed by flames.

words.ex: He goes to school on foot.
words.ex_cn: 他步行去学校。
words.en: By walking.

words.ex: They are on holiday in Spain.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在西班牙度假。
words.en: If you are on holiday, you are spending a period of time away from work or school, usually in order to relax or travel.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人的一边；支持某人
words.ex: Don't worry, I am on your side.
words.ex_cn: 别担心，我站在你这边。
words.en: Supporting or agreeing with someone in a dispute or argument.

words.ex: The shoes are on sale this week.
words.ex_cn: 这周鞋子在出售。
words.en: If products in a shop are on sale, they can be bought for less than their normal price.

words.ex: We will meet on Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们将在星期六见面。
words.en: During the day of the week following Friday.

words.tr: phrase. 展出的；陈列着的；公开展示的
words.ex: The paintings are on show at the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这些画正在博物馆展出。
words.en: If something is on show, it is being exhibited or displayed for people to see.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在地图上；重要的；为人所知的；有名气的
words.ex: Winning the competition really put our small town on the map.
words.ex_cn: 赢得比赛确实让我们的小镇出了名。
words.en: If a place is on the map, it is important or well known.

words.ex: On the one hand, I like coffee; on the other hand, I hate its taste.
words.ex_cn: 一方面，我喜欢咖啡；另一方面，我讨厌它的味道。
words.en: used to introduce the first of two contrasting points, facts, or ways of looking at something.

words.ex: I like coffee, on the other hand, my brother prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，另一方面，我弟弟更喜欢茶。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously

words.tr: phrase. 在操场上；在游乐场
words.ex: The children were playing on the playground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在操场上玩耍。
words.en: In the area designated for children to play, especially at a school.

words.tr: phrase. 在…的顶部；在…之上；完全掌控；除…之外
words.ex: She placed the book on the top of the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 她把书放在书架的顶部。
words.en: On the top of means at the highest part or point of something, or in addition to.

words.ex: He is on the way to school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在去学校的路上。
words.en: In the process of going somewhere or becoming something.

words.ex: He is on his way to school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在去学校的路上。
words.en: If you are on your way to a place, you are traveling towards it and have not yet arrived.

words.ex: He is on watch tonight.
words.ex_cn: 他今晚值班。
words.en: If someone is on watch, they are officially responsible for a particular task or area at a particular time, especially for guarding or monitoring something.

words.ex: He goes to school on weekdays.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作日去上学。
words.en: On weekdays refers to the days of the week from Monday to Friday, typically considered as the working days.

words.ex: They are on vacation in Spain.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在西班牙度假。
words.en: If someone is on vacation, they are spending a period of time away from home or work for relaxation or travel.

words.tr: phrase. 每年一次；一年一度
words.ex: We have a family reunion once a year.
words.ex_cn: 我们每年都会有一次家庭聚会。
words.en: Happening or done once every year.

words.ex: I eat ice cream once in a while.
words.ex_cn: 我偶尔吃冰淇淋。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.ex: He tried once more to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他再次尝试解决这个问题。
words.en: One more time; again.

words.ex: Once upon a time, a boy lived in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 从前，一个男孩住在一个小村庄里。
words.en: Used at the beginning of a story to indicate that it happened a long time ago.

words.tr: phrase. 陆续地；一个接一个地
words.ex: The children left the room one after another.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们一个接一个地离开了房间。
words.en: If things happen one after another, they happen in sequence, with little or no time in between.

words.tr: phrase. 另外一个人；彼此；相互
words.ex: The students helped one another with their homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们互相帮助做作业。
words.en: used to indicate that each of two or more people or things does something to or with the other(s)

words.tr: phrase. 一个……另一个……（用于列举或对比两个或多个事物）
words.ex: One student likes apples, another likes bananas.
words.ex_cn: 一个学生喜欢苹果，另一个喜欢香蕉。
words.en: used to refer to a first thing or person and then to a second thing or person

words.tr: phrase. 逐个地；一个接一个地；依次地
words.ex: The children left the room one by one.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们一个接一个地离开了房间。
words.en: Individually and in succession; one after another.

words.tr: 短语 一个……另一个……（用于指代两个事物或人中的每一个）
words.ex: I have two apples. One is red, the other is green.
words.ex_cn: 我有两个苹果。一个是红色的，另一个是绿色的。
words.en: Used to refer to the first and the second of two things

words.tr: phrase. 畅所欲言；打开；开放
words.ex: Please open up and tell me how you really feel.
words.ex_cn: 请畅所欲言，告诉我你真正的感受。
words.en: To make something available or accessible; to start or begin something.

words.ex: He is ten years old, or so.
words.ex_cn: 他十岁左右。
words.en: Approximately; used to indicate an estimate or rough quantity.

words.tr: phrase. 喘不过气来的；上气不接下气的
words.ex: He ran fast and was out of breath.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，气喘吁吁。
words.en: If you are out of breath, you are breathing very quickly and with difficulty, usually because you have been doing something energetic.

words.tr: phrase. 出故障的；次序颠倒的；不合规定的；不适的
words.ex: The elevator is out of order.
words.ex_cn: 电梯坏了。
words.en: If something is out of order, it is not working properly.

words.ex: This kind of clothing is out of style now.
words.ex_cn: 这种衣服现在过时了。
words.en: No longer in fashion or popular.

words.tr: phrase. 失业的；没有工作的
words.ex: He is out of work after the factory closed.
words.ex_cn: 工厂关闭后，他失业了。
words.en: If someone is out of work, they do not have a job.

words.tr: phrase. 一次又一次地；反复地；不断地
words.ex: He practiced the song over and over again.
words.ex_cn: 他一遍又一遍地练习这首歌。
words.en: Repeatedly; many times.

words.ex: The ball is over there.
words.ex_cn: 球在那边。
words.en: In or to that place; at a distance.

words.tr: phrase. …的一部分；属于…的组成部分
words.ex: This book is part of a big series.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是这套大系列的一部分。
words.en: If something is part of a group or organization, it belongs to it or is included in it.

words.ex: My grandfather passed away last year.
words.ex_cn: 我祖父去年去世了。
words.en: If someone passes away, they die.

words.tr: phrase. 把……传给……；将……交给……；将……转达给……
words.ex: He will pass on the message to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他会把消息转告给他的朋友。
words.en: To transmit or transfer something to someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 消磨时间；打发时间
words.ex: They played cards to pass the time during the long train ride.
words.ex_cn: 在漫长的火车旅行中，他们玩纸牌来消磨时光。
words.en: If you pass the time or pass the time of day, you spend time doing something in order to make the time go more quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 经过；通过；经历；经历并完成
words.ex: We pass through the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上都穿过公园。
words.en: To move or travel through a place or area.

words.ex: Please pay attention to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 请专心听老师讲课。
words.en: To focus one's mind or efforts on something or someone, especially in order to understand or learn.

words.tr: phrase. 不理会；不注意；对…不予理睬
words.ex: He pay no attention to the noise.
words.ex_cn: 他没有注意那个噪音。
words.en: To deliberately ignore or not take notice of something or someone.

words.ex: He will pay for the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他将为这杯咖啡付款。
words.en: To give money in exchange for goods or services; to suffer the consequences of one's actions.

words.tr: phrase. 还清；得到回报；取得成功
words.ex: He worked hard and finally paid off his debt.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，终于还清了债务。
words.en: If something you have done pays off, it is successful or brings a good result.

words.ex: He can pick out his toy from the box.
words.ex_cn: 他能从盒子里挑出他的玩具。
words.en: To choose someone or something from a group.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.tr: phrase. 名胜古迹；旅游景点；名胜
words.ex: We visited many places of interest during our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们在旅行中参观了许多名胜。
words.en: Places of interest refer to locations that are popular or significant for their cultural, historical, or natural features, attracting tourists and visitors.

words.ex: He played a joke on his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他跟朋友开了个玩笑。
words.en: To play a joke on someone means to trick them in a humorous way.

words.tr: phrase. 在...扮演一个角色；起作用
words.ex: Exercise plays a role in staying healthy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼在保持健康方面起作用。
words.en: To have a part or influence in something.

words.tr: phrase. 捉弄某人；对某人恶作剧
words.ex: He played a trick on his friend with a fake spider.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个假蜘蛛捉弄了他的朋友。
words.en: To play a trick on someone means to deceive them or make them the victim of a practical joke, often for amusement.

words.tr: phrase. 为…效力；为…而比赛；效力于（某球队）
words.ex: He will play for the school team tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将为学校队比赛。
words.en: To perform or compete for a team or organization.

words.ex: He plays the piano every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上弹钢琴。
words.en: To perform music on the piano.

words.ex: The children play with toys in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里玩玩具。
words.en: To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.ex: There is plenty of food on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌上有很多食物。
words.en: A large quantity or number; more than enough.

words.ex: He will point out the mistake in the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他将指出这道数学题中的错误。
words.en: To direct someone's attention to a particular fact or detail.

words.ex: He points to the door when he wants to leave.
words.ex_cn: 当他想离开时，他指向门。
words.en: To suggest or indicate something as being likely or true.

words.tr: phrase. 把……倒入……；大量投入（时间、金钱、精力等）
words.ex: He pours water into the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进玻璃杯里。
words.en: To cause a liquid to flow from a container into another place or container.

words.tr: phrase. 练习做某事；反复实践某事以熟练掌握
words.ex: You need to practice doing something to improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 你需要通过练习做某事来提高你的技能。
words.en: To perform an activity or exercise a skill repeatedly or regularly in order to improve or maintain one's proficiency.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.tr:
v. 赞美；赞扬
n. 赞美；赞扬
words.ex: His hard work received much praise from the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力工作得到了老师的许多赞美。
words.en: To express warm approval or admiration of someone for something they have done.

words.tr: phrase. 比起……更喜欢……；宁愿……而不……
words.ex: I prefer tea to coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you prefer one thing to another, you like the first thing better than the second.

words.w: prefer to do sth. rather than do sth.
words.tr: phrase. 宁愿做某事而不愿做某事；比起做某事更喜欢做某事
words.uk: /prɪˈfɜː(r) tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈrɑːðə(r) ðæn duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
words.us: /prɪˈfɜːr tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈræðər ðæn duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
words.ex: I prefer to read rather than watch TV.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢读书而不是看电视。
words.en: To like one thing or person better than another; to choose one thing rather than something else because you like it better.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet can prevent you from getting hurt.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔可以防止你受伤。
words.en: To stop someone from doing something or something from happening.

words.tr: phrase. 赞成与反对；正面与反面；利弊
words.ex: We listed the pros and cons before making a decision.
words.ex_cn: 我们在做决定之前列出了利弊。
words.en: The advantages and disadvantages of something, especially something that you are considering doing.

words.ex: He wears a helmet to protect his head.
words.ex_cn: 他戴头盔来保护头部。
words.en: If you protect someone or something, you prevent them from being harmed or damaged.

words.ex: The school provides free lunch for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: To make available for use; to supply.

words.tr: phrase. 拆毁（建筑物）；拉下；降低（价格、水平等）
words.ex: They pull down the old house to build a new school.
words.ex_cn: 他们拆掉旧房子来建一所新学校。
words.en: To pull down something means to destroy it or remove it from its position.

words.tr: phrase. 拔出；驶离路边；退出
words.ex: He pulled out a coin from his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他从口袋里掏出了一枚硬币。
words.en: To remove something or someone from a place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 收起来；杀死；关进监狱；放弃
words.ex: He put away his toys after playing.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具收起来了。
words.en: To put something away means to place it in its proper storage location, to save or store it, to consume it, or to confine someone in prison.

words.tr: phrase. 放下；记下；镇压；贬低；削减；杀死
words.ex: He put down his pen and smiled.
words.ex_cn: 他放下笔，笑了。
words.en: To place something on a surface or in a particular position; to write something down; to suppress or end something by force; to criticize someone in a way that makes them seem stupid or unimportant.

words.ex: He put forward a new idea in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个新想法。
words.en: To suggest or propose something for consideration.

words.ex: He put off his homework until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业推迟到明天。
words.en: To delay something or to cause someone to feel dislike or lack of interest.

words.tr: phrase. 穿戴；上演；增加（体重）
words.ex: He puts on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上外套。
words.en: To put on something means to dress oneself in it, or to start wearing it. It can also mean to produce a play, show, or other performance. Additionally, it can refer to gaining weight or to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality.

words.tr: phrase. v. 正在进行；上映；上演；（灯、机器等）开着
words.ex: He is on the bus now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在在公交车上。
words.en: To be in a state of operation or activity; to be happening or taking place.

words.tr: phrase. 扑灭；熄掉；伸出；发表；恼怒
words.ex: He put out the fire with a blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他用毯子扑灭了火。
words.en: To extinguish a fire or light; to publish or produce something; to extend or stretch out something.

words.tr: phrase. 把…放进…；把…投入…；把…翻译成…；使处于…状态
words.ex: He puts his books into his bag.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放进书包里。
words.en: To place something inside something else.

words.ex: He learned English and put it to use in his job.
words.ex_cn: 他学了英语，并在工作中加以运用。
words.en: To use something for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；张贴；建造；进行；提供；推举；提供食宿
words.ex: He put up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To provide someone with a place to stay temporarily; to build or erect something; to raise or lift something; to propose or suggest something; to display or post something; to increase the price of something.

words.ex: I can't put up with his loud noise every night.
words.ex_cn: 我无法忍受他每晚的噪音。
words.en: To tolerate or endure something unpleasant or annoying.

words.ex: They often quarrel about money.
words.ex_cn: 他们经常为钱争吵。
words.en: To argue or dispute about something, often in a heated or angry manner.

words.tr: phrase. 与…争吵；不同意；挑剔；对…提出质疑
words.ex: He often quarrels with his brother over small things.
words.ex_cn: 他经常因为小事和他弟弟吵架。
words.en: To have an angry argument or disagreement with someone.

words.ex: Quite a few students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 相当多的学生通过了考试。
words.en: You use quite a few to emphasize that you are referring to a considerable number of things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 宁可 ... 也不愿；与其 ... 倒不如；而不是
words.ex: He chose to walk rather than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: used to say that one thing is preferred to another or happens instead of another

words.tr: phrase. 向下伸手；俯身去够
words.ex: He can reach down to pick up the ball.
words.ex_cn: 他可以弯下腰去捡球。
words.en: To extend one's arm or hand downward to touch or grasp something.

words.ex: He reaches for the book on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他伸手去拿书架上的书。
words.en: To extend out an arm or hand in order to touch or grasp something; to strive to achieve or obtain something.

words.ex: He will reach out to his friend tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会联系他的朋友。
words.en: To make an effort to communicate with someone, especially in order to offer help or support.

words.tr: phrase. 阅读地图；查看地图；看懂地图
words.ex: He can read a map easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松地看懂地图。
words.en: To interpret and understand the symbols and markings on a map to determine location and navigate.

words.tr: phrase. 阅读一份报纸；看报纸
words.ex: He likes to read a newspaper every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天早上读报纸。
words.en: To look at and understand the words in a newspaper.

words.ex: I receive a letter from my friend every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周都收到朋友的一封信。
words.en: To get or be given something; to welcome someone officially or socially.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.tr: phrase. 拒绝做某事；不愿做某事
words.ex: He refuses to do something he thinks is wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝做他认为错误的事情。
words.en: To decline or reject a request or action.

words.tr: phrase. 把…视为…；认为…是…；把…看作…
words.ex: Many people regard him as a hero.
words.ex_cn: 许多人把他看作英雄。
words.en: To consider or think of someone or something in a specified way.

words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.tr: phrase. 记得曾经做过某事（强调动作已发生）
words.ex: I remember locking the door before I left.
words.ex_cn: 我记得离开前锁了门。
words.en: To recall or bring to mind an action or event that one has experienced in the past.

words.ex: Please remind me to call my mom tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请提醒我明天给我妈妈打电话。
words.en: If someone reminds you of a fact or event that you already know about, they say something which makes you think about it.

words.tr: phrase. 提醒某人去做某事
words.ex: My mom reminds me to do my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈提醒我做作业。
words.en: To cause someone to remember to do something.

words.tr:
v. 答复；回答；
n. 答复；回答；
words.ex: He replied to my message quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回复了我的消息。
words.en: To reply means to say or write something as an answer to something that someone has said or written.

words.tr:
n. 结果；
v. 导致；
words.ex: The result of the test was good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: A consequence, outcome, or effect of an action or situation.

words.ex: He left right away when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 他一听到消息就离开了。
words.en: If you do something right away, you do it immediately.

words.ex: He is eating lunch right now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在吃午饭。
words.en: At this very moment; immediately.

words.tr: phrase. v. 打电话；将（金额）记入收银机；记录销售额
words.ex: He will ring up his friend tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会给朋友打电话。
words.en: To call someone on the telephone; to record a sale on a cash register.

words.tr: phrase. 剥夺某人某物；抢劫某人某物
words.ex: The thieves robbed him of his wallet.
words.ex_cn: 小偷抢走了他的钱包。
words.en: To take something away from someone by force; to deprive someone of something.

words.tr: phrase. 经营一家公司；管理企业
words.ex: He runs a small company in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里经营一家小公司。
words.en: To manage or operate a business.

words.ex: The dog runs after the ball every time.
words.ex_cn: 每次狗都追球跑。
words.en: To chase or pursue someone or something, often in a literal sense of running behind them to catch up.

words.tr: phrase. 逃跑； 流掉；迅速离开
words.ex: The boy ran off with his brother's bike.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩骑着他哥哥的自行车跑掉了。
words.en: To leave a place or situation quickly and secretly, often to avoid a problem or responsibility; to produce copies of a document quickly; to discharge or release a liquid.

words.ex: We ran out of milk this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天早上牛奶喝完了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.ex: The traffic is heavy during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通很拥堵。
words.en: The rush hour is one of the periods of the day when most people are travelling to or from work.

words.ex: He rushed out to buy bread.
words.ex_cn: 他冲出去买面包了。
words.en: To leave or do something very quickly.

words.ex: The doctor saved the boy's life with quick action.
words.ex_cn: 医生通过迅速行动救了那个男孩的命。
words.en: To save someone's life means to prevent them from dying, often by providing medical treatment or performing a rescue.

words.ex: He saves up money to buy a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他存钱买一辆自行车。
words.en: To gradually collect money by saving it, especially for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 向……问好；代为向……致意
words.ex: He says hello to his neighbor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上向邻居问好。
words.en: To greet someone or acknowledge their presence with a hello.

words.ex: He says to himself, 'I can do this.'
words.ex_cn: 他对自己说：‘我能行。’
words.en: To speak to oneself, especially in a low voice or internally, often as a form of self-reflection or self-motivation.

words.ex: He is searching for his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他正在找他的钥匙。
words.en: To look for something carefully and thoroughly.

words.ex: They see a film every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周五看电影。
words.en: To watch a movie, typically in a cinema or at home.

words.ex: I will see my brother off at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我会去机场为我哥哥送行。
words.en: To accompany someone to the point of departure, especially as a gesture of farewell.

words.ex: The concert tickets sold out in one hour.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会的票在一小时内就卖光了。
words.en: To sell all of the available items or tickets for an event, so that there are no more left for people to buy.

words.tr: phrase. 派人去叫；派人去请；派人去取
words.ex: He will send for a doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会请医生过来。
words.en: To ask or order that someone or something be brought to you, especially by sending a message.

words.ex: He sends the letter to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把信寄给他的朋友。
words.en: to dispatch or cause to go to a particular place or person

words.tr: phrase. 送上去；发射；嘲笑，讽刺（尤指模仿某人或某事以取笑）
words.ex: The students like to send up the teacher with funny voices.
words.ex_cn: 学生们喜欢用滑稽的声音模仿老师。
words.en: To launch or propel something upwards; to mock or parody someone or something in a humorous way.

words.tr: phrase. 树立榜样；以身作则
words.ex: He sets an example by arriving early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早到，树立了榜样。
words.en: To behave in a way that other people should copy.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.ex: He set the paper on fire with a match.
words.ex_cn: 他用火柴把纸点燃了。
words.en: To cause something to start burning.

words.ex: I need to set the alarm clock for 6 AM.
words.ex_cn: 我需要把闹钟调到早上6点。
words.en: To adjust the alarm clock to ring at a specific time.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.tr: phrase. 与……握手（表示问候、祝贺或达成协议）
words.ex: They shake hands with each other after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议结束后他们互相握手。
words.en: To clasp and move someone's hand up and down as a gesture of greeting, agreement, or farewell.

words.tr:
v. 共享；分享；
n. 分享；股份；
words.ex: They share their food with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们与朋友分享食物。
words.en: If you share something with another person, you both have it, use it, or are involved in it. You can also say that two people share something.

words.ex: He left home, and shortly after, it started to rain.
words.ex_cn: 他离开家后不久，就开始下雨了。
words.en: A short time after something else has happened.

words.tr: phrase. 肩并肩地；齐心协力地
words.ex: They worked shoulder to shoulder to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他们并肩工作完成了这个项目。
words.en: If people work or act shoulder to shoulder, they work together in order to achieve something, often in a difficult situation.

words.tr: phrase. ...对···大声喊，冲···嚷嚷【动词短语】
words.ex: He shouts at his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上对他的狗大喊大叫。
words.en: to say something in a loud voice, especially when you are angry, excited, or want to attract someone's attention

words.tr: phrase. 对……表现出兴趣；关心……
words.ex: He shows interest in playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他对弹钢琴表现出兴趣。
words.en: To express curiosity or concern about something or someone.

words.ex: He likes to show off his new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢炫耀他的新自行车。
words.en: If someone shows off, they behave in a way that is intended to attract attention and impress people, often by displaying their abilities or possessions.

words.ex: He showed me around the school.
words.ex_cn: 他带我参观了学校。
words.en: to guide someone on a tour of a place, making them familiar with it

words.tr: phrase. 给某人指路；引导某人前往某处
words.ex: He showed me the way to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他给我指了去车站的路。
words.en: To guide someone to a destination by indicating the correct path or direction.

words.tr:
v. 展示；表明；给...看
n. 演出；节目；展览会；表现
words.ex: He shows his photos to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友们展示他的照片。
words.en: To display or allow someone to see something.

words.tr: phrase. 出示票证；展示票据
words.ex: He shows the ticket at the gate.
words.ex_cn: 他在门口出示票。
words.en: to present a ticket for inspection or validation

words.ex: He did not show up for class yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有来上课。
words.en: If someone shows up, they arrive somewhere, especially unexpectedly or after they have been waiting a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 关闭；住口；关严；监禁；封藏
words.ex: Shut up, please, I'm trying to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 闭嘴，求你了，我在睡觉。
words.en: If you tell someone to shut up, you are rudely telling them to stop talking.

words.ex: The two boys sat side by side on the bench.
words.ex_cn: 两个男孩并排坐在长凳上。
words.en: If two or more things are side by side, they are next to each other.

words.tr: phrase. 热烈称赞某人；颂扬某人
words.ex: They sing her praises for helping the team win.
words.ex_cn: 他们称赞她帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: To speak very highly of someone; to praise someone greatly.

words.tr: phrase. 热烈赞扬某人或某事物；歌颂……的优点
words.ex: He sings his daughter's praises every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天称赞他的女儿。
words.en: To speak very highly of someone or something; to extol the virtues of someone or something.

words.ex: Please sit down and wait for the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 请坐下等老师。
words.en: To lower one's body into a seated position.

words.ex: The car will slow down at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯处会减速。
words.en: To reduce one's speed or the speed of a vehicle or process.

words.ex: He woke up early so as to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早早起床，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: with the purpose of; in order to

words.ex: So far, he has finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到目前为止，他已经完成了作业。
words.en: Up to the present moment; until now.

words.ex: He studied hard so that he could pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以便通过考试。
words.en: Used to indicate that something happens to such a degree that something else happens as a result.

words.ex: He solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: If you solve a problem or a question, you find a solution or an answer to it.

words.tr: phrase. 来日；将来的某一日；有朝一日
words.ex: I will travel to Paris some day.
words.ex_cn: 我有一天会去巴黎旅行。
words.en: At some time in the future, but not specifying exactly when.

words.ex: I will call you sometime next week.
words.ex_cn: 我下周某个时候给你打电话。
words.en: At some unspecified or unknown time.

words.tr: 一些……另一些……（用于表示部分与部分之间的对比或列举不同群体）
words.ex: Some people like apples, others like bananas.
words.ex_cn: 有些人喜欢苹果，有些人喜欢香蕉。
words.en: Used to indicate that there are different groups or categories within a larger set, with each group having its own preferences, characteristics, or behaviors.

words.ex: Sooner or later, he will finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 迟早他会完成他的作业。
words.en: If you say that something will happen sooner or later, you mean that it will happen at some time in the future, even though it might take a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 听起来像；似乎像（用于描述某事物给人的听觉印象或感觉）
words.ex: It sounds like rain outside.
words.ex_cn: 外面听起来像下雨了。
words.en: To seem to be something when heard.

words.ex: He had a sound sleep last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚睡得很香。
words.en: A deep and restful sleep.

words.tr: phrase. 高度赞扬；对……评价很高
words.ex: They speak highly of the new teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他们对这位新老师评价很高。
words.en: To express a very favorable opinion of someone or something.

words.ex: Speak of the devil, he just walked in.
words.ex_cn: 说曹操，曹操就到，他刚走进来。
words.en: To mention or discuss someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 与…交谈；向…说话；涉及，关乎
words.ex: I will speak to my teacher tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要和我的老师谈谈。
words.en: To address someone directly in speech; to communicate with someone verbally.

words.ex: He pressed the button to speed up the video.
words.ex_cn: 他按了按钮来加快视频速度。
words.en: To increase the speed or rate of something.

words.ex: He spends money on books.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱买书。
words.en: To spend means to use money to buy or pay for something, or to use time or energy in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 支持；遵守；袖手旁观；准备行动
words.ex: I will stand by you when you face difficulties.
words.ex_cn: 当你遇到困难时，我会支持你。
words.en: To be ready to support or act if needed; to wait in a state of readiness.

words.tr: phrase. 代表；象征；支持；容忍
words.ex: The letter A stands for apple.
words.ex_cn: 字母A代表苹果。
words.en: If you say that a letter stands for a particular word, you mean that it is an abbreviation for that word.

words.ex: The students stand up when the teacher enters the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 当老师走进教室时，学生们站起来。
words.en: If you stand up, you rise to your feet from a sitting or lying position.

words.tr: phrase. 创建一个俱乐部；发起成立一个社团
words.ex: They want to start a club for book lovers.
words.ex_cn: 他们想成立一个爱书者的俱乐部。
words.en: to establish or initiate a new organization or group

words.tr: phrase. 开始；出发；起初从事（某事）
words.ex: He starts out as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始是一名老师。
words.en: To begin a journey or a process.

words.ex: He starts to do his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后开始做作业。
words.en: to begin an action or process

words.ex: He starts doing his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后开始做作业。
words.en: to begin an action or process

words.ex: Stay away from the dog; it is angry.
words.ex_cn: 离那只狗远点，它很生气。
words.en: To avoid going near someone or something, especially because it is dangerous or could cause problems.

words.ex: You should eat vegetables and exercise to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 你应该吃蔬菜并锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: To remain in good physical and mental condition.

words.ex: He stays up late to watch movies.
words.ex_cn: 他熬夜看电影。
words.en: To remain awake and not go to bed.

words.ex: He solved the math problem step by step.
words.ex_cn: 他一步一步地解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Proceeding gradually from one stage to the next.

words.tr: phrase. 粘附；坚持；紧跟；忠于
words.ex: The glue will stick the paper to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水会把纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: If you stick to a promise, agreement, decision, or principle, you do what you said you would do, or do not change your mind.

words.ex: He stopped doing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他停止做作业了。
words.en: To cease to do a particular activity or action.

words.tr: phrase. 为……而学习；为……做准备（如考试、资格等）
words.ex: He is studying for the test tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为明天的考试学习。
words.en: To spend time learning about a subject, especially in preparation for an examination.

words.ex: He will succeed in passing the test.
words.ex_cn: 他会成功通过考试。
words.en: To achieve something that you have been aiming for.

words.ex: It is such a fine day that we go for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气这么好，我们去散步了。
words.en: a day of exceptional quality or pleasantness

words.ex: He suffers from a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他患了重感冒。
words.en: If you suffer from an illness or from a medical condition, you are badly affected by it.

words.ex: Can you sum up the total cost?
words.ex_cn: 你能合计一下总费用吗？
words.en: If you sum something up, you briefly describe the main features or ideas of it.

words.ex: He likes to surf the internet after school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢放学后上网。
words.en: To browse the World Wide Web.

words.tr: phrase. 深呼吸（用于放松或准备应对某事）
words.ex: Take a deep breath and relax.
words.ex_cn: 深呼吸一下，放松一下。
words.en: To inhale a large amount of air into the lungs, typically as a preparation for exertion or as a method of relaxation.

words.tr: phrase. 给某人捎个口信；给某人留言
words.ex: Can you take a message for me?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我捎个口信吗？
words.en: To write down or remember a message that someone else has given you, in order to pass it on to another person.

words.tr: phrase. 乘坐（交通工具）；搭车；兜风
words.ex: He will take a ride on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他将坐公交车去兜风。
words.en: To go for a journey in a vehicle, especially for pleasure.

words.ex: He takes after his father in looks.
words.ex_cn: 他在长相上像他父亲。
words.en: If you take after a member of your family, you resemble them in your appearance, your behaviour, or your character.

words.tr: phrase. 就座；坐下（指正式或指定的位置）
words.ex: Please take your seat before the movie starts.
words.ex_cn: 电影开始前请就座。
words.en: To sit down in a place that has been prepared or assigned for one, especially in a formal or public setting.

words.ex: He will take part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参加学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To be involved in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. 积极参与；在……中起积极作用
words.ex: He takes an active part in class discussions.
words.ex_cn: 他积极参与课堂讨论。
words.en: To involve oneself actively in an activity or event.

words.ex: He took a risk and started his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他冒了一个险，开了自己的公司。
words.en: To do something that involves the possibility of danger, loss, or failure.

words.ex: They will take a vacation next month.
words.ex_cn: 他们下个月要去度假。
words.en: To take a vacation means to take time off from work or daily activities to relax or travel.

words.tr: phrase. 采取行动；提出诉讼
words.ex: He must take action now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在必须采取行动。
words.en: To do something in order to deal with a situation or problem.

words.ex: He took advantage of the free tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他利用了免费的票。
words.en: To use a particular situation to do or get what you want.

words.ex: He will take an exam tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要参加考试。
words.en: To participate in a test or examination to assess one's knowledge or proficiency in a particular subject.

words.ex: He takes an interest in birds.
words.ex_cn: 他对鸟类感兴趣。
words.en: To become interested in something or someone.

words.ex: He takes away the toys after playtime.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具拿走。
words.en: To remove something from a place or to subtract a number or amount from another.

words.tr: phrase. 拿回；收回；取消；使回忆起
words.ex: I will take back my book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我会从图书馆拿回我的书。
words.en: To take something back means to return something to the place it came from, or to admit that something you said was wrong.

words.ex: Take care when you cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 过马路时要小心。
words.en: To be cautious or attentive; to look after someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 照顾；照料；处理；应付
words.ex: She takes care of her little brother after school.
words.ex_cn: 她放学后照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To look after someone or something; to deal with something.

words.ex: He will take charge of the project next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将负责这个项目。
words.en: To assume control or responsibility over something.

words.tr: phrase. 采取不同的路线；选择不同的路径
words.ex: They take different routes to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天走不同的路线去学校。
words.en: To choose or follow different paths or directions to reach a destination.

words.ex: He takes exercise every morning in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在公园里锻炼。
words.en: To perform physical activities in order to stay healthy and improve physical fitness.

words.ex: He takes hold of the rope to climb up.
words.ex_cn: 他抓住绳子往上爬。
words.en: To grasp or seize something with the hands; to gain control or influence over something.

words.tr: phrase. 吸收；领会；接待；接受
words.ex: Plants take in sunlight to make food.
words.ex_cn: 植物吸收阳光来制造食物。
words.en: To take something in means to understand it or to absorb it. It can also mean to deceive someone or to make clothes smaller.

words.tr: phrase. 放轻松；别紧张；悠着点
words.ex: Take it easy, the test is not hard.
words.ex_cn: 别紧张，考试不难。
words.en: To relax and not do anything too energetic or stressful.

words.ex: He takes notes during the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时做笔记。
words.en: To write down information, especially during a lecture or meeting, in order to remember it later.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.tr: phrase. 采纳建议；接受忠告
words.ex: He takes his father's advice about work.
words.ex_cn: 他听从父亲关于工作的建议。
words.en: To accept and act upon someone's suggestions or recommendations.

words.ex: The nurse takes her temperature every morning.
words.ex_cn: 护士每天早上给她量体温。
words.en: To measure someone's body temperature, usually to check for fever.

words.tr: phrase. 慢慢来；不着急；从容不迫地做某事
words.ex: He takes his time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢做作业，不着急。
words.en: To use as much time as one needs, without hurrying.

words.tr: phrase. 拿出；取出；去掉；取得；领到
words.ex: He took out his keys to open the door.
words.ex_cn: 他拿出钥匙开门。
words.en: To remove something from a place or to take something with you when you go somewhere.

words.tr: phrase. 从…中取出；使脱离；减少（某物）的量
words.ex: He takes the book out of the bag.
words.ex_cn: 他把书从包里拿出来。
words.en: To remove something from a place or container.

words.ex: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: When something takes place, it happens, especially in a controlled or organized way.

words.ex: He takes pride in helping others.
words.ex_cn: 他以帮助别人为荣。
words.en: To feel a sense of satisfaction or pleasure in one's own achievements, qualities, or possessions, or those of someone with whom one is closely associated.

words.tr: phrase. 代替某人；取代某人的位置
words.ex: He will take his brother's place in the game.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替他哥哥参加比赛。
words.en: To take someone's place means to do something that another person was going to do, because they are unable to do it.

words.ex: He takes medicine every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃药。
words.en: To take medicine means to consume a substance, usually in the form of a pill or liquid, that is intended to treat or prevent disease or illness.

words.tr: phrase. 随身携带某物（与某人同行时）
words.ex: He took his lunch with his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友一起带了午餐。
words.en: To carry or bring something along with oneself.

words.ex: Computers can take the place of typewriters.
words.ex_cn: 计算机可以取代打字机。
words.en: To take the place of something or someone means to replace them or to be used instead of them.

words.tr: phrase. 认真地对待…；严肃地看待…
words.ex: I take my brother seriously when he talks about his dreams.
words.ex_cn: 当我哥哥谈论他的梦想时，我会认真对待他。
words.en: To consider someone or their opinions, feelings, or actions as important and deserving of attention.

words.tr: phrase. 认真地对待…；严肃地看待…
words.ex: He takes his homework seriously.
words.ex_cn: 他认真对待他的作业。
words.en: To regard something as important and deserving of attention or concern.

words.tr: phrase. 带……去……；把……带到……；使……进入某种状态或位置
words.ex: I take my brother to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上带我弟弟去学校。
words.en: To bring someone or something to a particular place.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.ex: We should talk about the plan for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该谈谈明天的计划。
words.en: To discuss or mention a particular subject.

words.tr:
v. 说话；交谈
n. 谈话
words.ex: They talk every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后都会交谈。
words.en: To speak to someone in order to give information or express ideas or feelings; to have a conversation with someone.

words.ex: I talk with my friend every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天和我的朋友聊天。
words.en: To have a conversation with someone.

words.ex: He teaches himself English with a book.
words.ex_cn: 他用一本书自学英语。
words.en: To learn something by oneself without the help of a teacher.

words.tr: phrase. 给某人一个教训；使某人吸取教训
words.ex: He failed the test, and it taught him a lesson.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，这给他上了一课。
words.en: To make someone realize that they have done something wrong, especially by punishing them or making them suffer in some way.

words.ex: He tells a lie to avoid trouble.
words.ex_cn: 他撒谎以避免麻烦。
words.en: To say something that is not true in order to deceive someone.

words.tr: phrase. 讲述一个故事；说一个故事
words.ex: He was known to tell a story to cover up his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他以说谎来掩盖自己的错误而闻名。
words.en: To narrate or recount a tale or narrative, often with the intent to entertain or inform.

words.tr: phrase. 区分；分辨（常用于指区分两个或多个相似的人或物）
words.ex: I can't tell the twins apart.
words.ex_cn: 我分不清这对双胞胎。
words.en: To recognize or understand the difference between two or more things or people.

words.ex: He can tell the truth to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他可以对他的老师说实话。
words.en: To speak honestly; to not lie or deceive.

words.tr: 短语. 因某事而感谢（某人）
words.ex: I thanks for your help.
words.ex_cn: 我感谢你的帮助。
words.en: used to express gratitude for something

words.ex: I thank you for your help.
words.ex_cn: 我谢谢你帮助我。
words.en: To express gratitude to someone for something they have done.

words.ex: Thanks to his help, I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 多亏了他的帮助，我通过了考试。
words.en: used to say that something good has happened because of someone or something

words.ex: The key to passing the test is practice.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的关键是练习。
words.en: The essential factor or solution to achieving something.

words.ex: This book is the same as that one.
words.ex_cn: 这本书和那本书一样。
words.en: Identical or equivalent to something else.

words.ex: I think about my future every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天都会思考我的未来。
words.en: To consider or reflect on something.

words.tr: phrase. 想到；想起；有...的看法
words.ex: I think of my mom when I eat cookies.
words.ex_cn: 当我吃饼干时，我想起我的妈妈。
words.en: To have a particular idea or opinion about something or someone; to consider something or someone in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细考虑；想出（解决方案或计划）
words.ex: He thinks out the answer carefully before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他在说话前仔细思考答案。
words.en: To think something out means to consider it carefully and thoroughly before making a decision or taking action.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细考虑；重新考虑
words.ex: I need time to think over your offer.
words.ex_cn: 我需要时间考虑你的提议。
words.en: To consider carefully before making a decision.

words.tr: phrase. 想出；构思出（主意、计划等）
words.ex: He can think up new ideas very fast.
words.ex_cn: 他能很快想出新点子。
words.en: To invent or devise something.

words.ex: Thousands of people attended the concert.
words.ex_cn: 数千人参加了这场音乐会。
words.en: A large number of something, typically more than a thousand.

words.tr: phrase. 一天三次；每日三次
words.ex: He takes medicine three times a day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天服药三次。
words.en: Adverb indicating the frequency of an action, specifically three occurrences within a day.

words.tr: phrase. 随意乱扔；漫不经心地抛掷
words.ex: He likes to throw about big words to impress people.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢乱用大词来给人留下印象。
words.en: To throw something about means to throw it in various directions without much thought or care.

words.tr: phrase. 随意抛掷；漫不经心地使用（如想法、指责等）
words.ex: He likes to throw around big words to sound smart.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢乱用大词来显得聪明。
words.en: To use or spend something in a careless or excessive way; to mention something often in conversation without giving it serious consideration.

words.ex: He threw away the old book.
words.ex_cn: 他扔掉了那本旧书。
words.en: To dispose of something that is no longer useful or wanted; to waste an opportunity or advantage.

words.tr: phrase. 整理；收拾干净；使整洁
words.ex: He will tidy up the room after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐后会收拾房间。
words.en: To make a place neat and orderly by removing clutter and arranging things properly.

words.tr: phrase. 扎牢；妥善解决；密切联系；占用；合伙；停泊
words.ex: He will tie up the loose rope.
words.ex_cn: 他会把松开的绳子系好。
words.en: To tie up means to fasten or secure something with a cord, rope, or the like. It can also mean to occupy or engage someone or something completely, leaving no time or resources for other activities.

words.ex: To be honest, I don't like this food.
words.ex_cn: 老实说，我不喜欢这种食物。
words.en: used when you are telling someone what you really think

words.tr: 令人失望的是；使某人感到失望的是
words.ex: To his disappointment, the game was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 让他失望的是，比赛被取消了。
words.en: Used to express that something has caused someone to feel disappointed.

words.ex: To his joy, the dog came back home.
words.ex_cn: 令他高兴的是，狗回到了家。
words.en: Used to express that something happens that makes someone feel very happy.

words.ex: To my surprise, he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 让我惊讶的是，他通过了考试。
words.en: used to express that someone is surprised by something

words.ex: To some extent, he likes the new job.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他喜欢这份新工作。
words.en: To some extent means to a certain degree or in a certain measure, but not completely.

words.ex: To start with, we need some water.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要一些水。
words.en: You use 'to start with' when you are mentioning the first or most basic thing in a series of things, or when you are giving the first or most basic reason for something.

words.ex: To tell the truth, I did not finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 说实话，我没有完成作业。
words.en: Used to emphasize that one is being completely honest about something.

words.ex: He ate too much candy and felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了太多糖果，感觉不舒服。
words.en: An excessive amount; more than is necessary or desirable.

words.tr: phrase. 太……而不能……（用于表达程度过高导致无法做某事）
words.ex: He is too tired to walk.
words.ex_cn: 他太累了，走不动了。
words.en: Used to say that something is not possible because a quality or condition is too extreme.

words.ex: We should treat everyone as a friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该把每个人都当作朋友。
words.en: To consider or regard someone or something in a specified way.

words.tr: phrase. 与…谈判；与…协商；对待
words.ex: The government will treat with the union to solve the strike.
words.ex_cn: 政府将与工会谈判以解决罢工问题。
words.en: To handle or manage something in a particular way, especially using a specific substance or method.

words.ex: She wants to try on the new dress.
words.ex_cn: 她想试穿那条新裙子。
words.en: To put on a piece of clothing to see if it fits or if you like it.

words.tr: phrase. 尽力而为；竭尽全力
words.ex: I will try my best to finish the homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 我会尽力按时完成作业。
words.en: To make the greatest possible effort to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 参加…选拔；测试；试验
words.ex: He wants to try out for the school soccer team.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加校足球队的选拔。
words.en: To test something to see if it is suitable or effective.

words.tr: phrase. 努力做某事；试图做某事
words.ex: I try to do my homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上都试着做作业。
words.en: to make an attempt or effort to do something

words.tr: phrase. 转身；（使）好转；（使）扭转局面
words.ex: He heard a noise and told me to turn around.
words.ex_cn: 他听到一声响动，叫我转过身来。
words.en: To change direction so as to face the opposite way; to change something bad into something good.

words.ex: Please turn down the volume, it's too loud.
words.ex_cn: 请把音量调低，太大声了。
words.en: To refuse or reject an offer or request; to reduce the volume, temperature, or intensity of something.

words.tr:
v. 转身；转弯；转动；转变
n. 轮到的机会；拐弯；转变
words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在你离开前关掉灯。
words.en: To change something into a different form or state.

words.ex: Turn left at the corner.
words.ex_cn: 在拐角处左转。
words.en: To change direction towards the left.

words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前请关灯。
words.en: If you turn off a device or machine, you stop it from operating by pressing a button or moving a switch.

words.tr: phrase. 开启；接通；发动；突击
words.ex: He turns on the light in the room.
words.ex_cn: 他打开了房间的灯。
words.en: To cause something to start operating, especially by pressing a switch or button.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；生产；结果是；关闭；朝外
words.ex: The weather turned out to be sunny.
words.ex_cn: 天气结果是晴朗的。
