words.en: If something turns out a particular way, it happens in that way or has the result or degree of success indicated. If you turn out something, you produce or create it. If you turn out a light, you switch it off.

words.tr: phrase. 翻转；移交；换台；营业额达到；反复考虑
words.ex: He turned over the pancake with a spatula.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子把煎饼翻了个面。
words.en: To cause something to move so that a different side is facing upwards; to transfer or hand over something to someone else; to achieve a certain amount of business.

words.tr: phrase. 突然出现；重新露面；调大
words.ex: He didn't turn up to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他没有出席会议。
words.en: To arrive or appear somewhere, often unexpectedly; to increase the volume or intensity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 上上下下；前前后后
words.ex: The ball goes up and down when he throws it.
words.ex_cn: 当他扔球时，球上下弹跳。
words.en: Moving alternately upwards and downwards or back and forth.

words.ex: The picture is upside down.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片是倒着的。
words.en: If something is upside down, it is in a position in which the part that is usually at the bottom is at the top.

words.ex: He used up all the water.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有的水都用完了。
words.en: To consume or exhaust something completely.

words.tr: phrase. 过去曾经···【动词短语】
words.ex: He used to be a teacher before he became a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他在成为医生之前是一名老师。
words.en: If something used to be a particular thing, it was that thing in the past but is not that thing now.

words.tr: 短语. 过去常常做某事（表示过去习惯性或经常性的动作，现在已不再如此）
words.ex: I used to play football every day when I was young.
words.ex_cn: 我小时候每天都踢足球。
words.en: If you used to do something, you did it regularly in the past, but you no longer do it.

words.ex: I wait for the bus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上等公交车。
words.en: To remain in a place until a particular time or until something else happens.

words.ex: He waits in line for the bus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上排队等公交车。
words.en: To stand in a line and wait for one's turn.

words.ex: I wake up at seven every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上七点醒来。
words.en: To stop sleeping and become conscious, or to make someone stop sleeping.

words.tr: phrase. 沿着…步行而下；步行经过
words.ex: He walks down the street to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他沿着街道步行去公园。
words.en: To move along on foot at a moderate pace, especially in a specified direction.

words.tr: phrase. 想要做某事；有做某事的意愿或欲望
words.ex: I want to do something fun today.
words.ex_cn: 我想今天做点有趣的事情。
words.en: to have a desire or wish to do something

words.ex: I want him to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 我想让他打扫他的房间。
words.en: To desire someone to perform a specific action.

words.tr: v. 警告；告诫；提醒注意；
words.ex: The teacher warned the students not to be late.
words.ex_cn: 老师警告学生不要迟到。
words.en: If you warn someone about something such as a possible danger or problem, you tell them about it so that they are aware of it.

words.tr: phrase. 洗餐具；洗脸和手；将...冲上岸；结束；毁掉
words.ex: He washes up after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他饭后洗碗。
words.en: To clean the dishes, cutlery, and other utensils used in preparing and eating a meal; to clean one's hands and face.

words.ex: We watch a match on TV every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每个星期天在电视上看比赛。
words.en: to view a sporting contest or game

words.ex: Watch out for the dog near the fence.
words.ex_cn: 小心篱笆附近的狗。
words.en: If you watch out for something, you are careful to notice it or to pay attention to it, often because it might cause you harm or trouble.

words.ex: He watches TV every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视。
words.en: To view television programs for entertainment or information.

words.tr:
int. 欢迎；
v. 欢迎；
adj. 受欢迎的；
n. 欢迎；
words.ex: Welcome to our school!
words.ex_cn: 欢迎来到我们的学校！
words.en: If you welcome someone, you greet them in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere.

words.tr: phrase. 要是……怎么办；倘若……会怎样
words.ex: What if it rains tomorrow?
words.ex_cn: 如果明天下雨怎么办？
words.en: You use what if at the beginning of a question when you ask about the consequences of something happening, especially something undesirable.

words.ex: He likes reading books, and what's more, he writes his own stories.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读书，而且他还写自己的故事。
words.en: used to add information that emphasizes what you have just said.

words.tr: phrase. （非正式）怎么了？最近怎么样？有什么事吗？
words.ex: What's up?
words.ex_cn: 怎么了？
words.en: used as a friendly greeting and to ask someone how they are or what is happening

words.ex: I wish him to come early.
words.ex_cn: 我希望他早点来。
words.en: To desire or want someone to do something.

words.ex: He solved the math problem with difficulty.
words.ex_cn: 他费力地解出了这道数学题。
words.en: With difficulty means in a way that is not easy or involves a lot of effort.

words.ex: He handled the glass with great care.
words.ex_cn: 他非常小心地处理了玻璃。
words.en: To do something with great care means to do it very carefully, paying attention to detail and avoiding mistakes.

words.tr: phrase. 异口同声地；一致地
words.ex: The crowd shouted with one voice.
words.ex_cn: 人群齐声呼喊。
words.en: If a group of people say something with one voice, they all express the same opinion about something.

words.ex: I saw the big mountain with my own eyes.
words.ex_cn: 我亲眼看到了那座大山。
words.en: To see something personally, without relying on others' accounts or media representations.

words.ex: I will help you with pleasure.
words.ex_cn: 我很乐意帮你。
words.en: If you say that you will do something with pleasure, you are emphasizing that you are very willing to do it.

words.ex: He solved the math problem with the help of his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师的帮助下解决了这道数学题。
words.en: With the assistance or support of someone or something.

words.ex: He went to the library with the purpose of finding some research materials.
words.ex_cn: 他去图书馆是为了找到一些研究资料。
words.en: With the intention of achieving something.

words.tr: phrase. 未经许可地；擅自地
words.ex: He entered the room without permission.
words.ex_cn: 他未经允许就进了房间。
words.en: If you do something without permission, you do it without asking for or receiving the approval of the person in authority.

words.ex: He works as a teacher at a small school.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小学校当老师。
words.en: To perform the duties or functions of a particular role or job.

words.tr: phrase. 从事于…；继续工作；设法说服；影响
words.ex: He works on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都做家庭作业。
words.en: To spend time repairing or improving something.

words.tr: phrase. 想知道是否……（用于表达疑问或不确定）
words.ex: I wonder if he will come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我想知道他明天是否会来。
words.en: to think about something with curiosity or doubt, often expressing a desire to know whether something is true or will happen

words.tr: phrase. 为…工作；受雇于…；效力于…
words.ex: He works for a big company in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里的一家大公司工作。
words.en: to be employed by a particular company or organization

words.tr: phrase. 算出；解决；锻炼；进展（顺利）
words.ex: I can work out the answer with a calculator.
words.ex_cn: 我可以用计算器算出答案。
words.en: If you work out a solution to a problem or mystery, you think about it and find a solution. If you work out the answer to a mathematical problem, you calculate it. If a plan or situation works out, it happens or progresses in a particular way.

words.ex: Don't worry about the test. You will do well.
words.ex_cn: 别担心考试，你会考好的。
words.en: To feel anxious or concerned about something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 想要做某事（用于表达愿望或礼貌请求）
words.ex: I would like to eat an apple.
words.ex_cn: 我想吃一个苹果。
words.en: Used to express a desire or intention to do something.

words.tr: 短语：很想做某事；非常愿意做某事
words.ex: I would love to eat pizza tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚很想吃披萨。
words.en: To express a strong desire or willingness to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 宁愿……也不……（用于表达偏好或选择）
words.ex: I would rather walk than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: Used to indicate a preference for one thing over another.

words.ex: Please write down your name.
words.ex_cn: 请写下你的名字。
words.en: To record something in writing.

words.tr: phrase. 给某人写信；写信给某人
words.ex: I write to my friend every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周给我的朋友写信。
words.en: To communicate with someone by sending them a letter or email.

words.ex: He works hard year after year.
words.ex_cn: 他年复一年地努力工作。
words.en: If something happens year after year, it happens regularly every year.

words.tr: phrase. 逐年；一年又一年地
words.ex: The town grows bigger year by year.
words.ex_cn: 这个城镇一年比一年大。
words.en: If something changes year by year, it changes gradually each year.
